articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition: A Comparative Study of Pre-trained Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of facial emotion detection methodologies, highlighting a robust approach that encompasses key stages such as face detection, feature extraction, and emotion classification. Central to this approach are convolutional neural networks (CNNs), specifically leveraging architectures of pre-trained models like VGG16 and DenseNet121. These CNNs are adept at automatically learning discriminative features from facial images, enabling the system to accurately discern between various emotional states and assign corresponding labels. Our findings revealed that VGG16 and DenseNet121 emerged as the top performers among the models examined, achieving an impressive accuracy score of 86%, surpassing the ensemble model. In the evaluation phase, the system demonstrates impressive performance metrics, with VGG16 and DenseNet121 consistently outperforming the random ensemble model’s with a 0.86% accuracy. The efficacy of deep learning architectures in capturing nuanced facial expressions and facilitating accurate emotion recognition. The study does, however, admit a number of difficulties with facial emotion recognition. Facial expression variability among people, groups, and cultures presents a major challenge, requiring strong training and generalization of the model. Moreover, any biases or inadequate representation of specific demographics in the FER-2013 dataset could affect the system’s effectiveness and generalizability.Moreover, the computational resources required for training and deploying deep learning models represent another hurdle. The complexity of CNN architectures and the computational intensity of training processes may impose practical constraints, especially in resource-constrained environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security in Cloud Native Applications: A Blockchain-Based Approach for Container Image Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study shows the analysis on how important it is to keep data safe, especially in new types of computer programs called “Cloud Native Applications”. These apps are made quickly and automatically, but sometimes they are not as safe as they should be. The study looks at using blockchain, a special kind of technology, to make a system that keeps track of problems in these apps. During the research, the study looks closely at how well the blockchain system works. It checks if it can help make cloud native apps safer. The study looks at the main parts of these apps, called “container images” to look for any problems. The research also shows that there are big safety issues, especially with container images that stick around for a long time. This is happening because cloud native apps are made fast, and safety often gets overlooked. The study suggests using blockchain to fix these safety problems. Blockchain can make a list of all the issues with cloud native apps, and it cannot be changed or hidden, this makes it easier for everyone involved to see what’s wrong and work together to fix it. We also look at how well the blockchain system works in real situations. By studying the data collected, the study gives useful information to people who want to make their cloud native apps safer.

articleTitle: Advancing Dermatology: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks for Timely Hair Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Hair and scalp diseases represent a significant medical challenge, affecting millions worldwide. Early and accurate detection of these conditions is crucial for effective treatment and management. The proposed system integrates advanced DL algorithms with image processing methodologies to analyze digital images of the scalp and hair. By leveraging a diverse dataset of annotated images, the system employs supervised learning techniques to train models capable of recognizing patterns indicative of different hair and scalp diseases. Feature extraction, segmentation, and classification algorithms are applied to process and interpret image data, facilitating accurate diagnosis and classification of conditions such as alopecia, dandruff, psoriasis, and fungal infections. In this research, a deep learning technique was employed to accurately forecast ten major categories of hair loss and scalp disorders, including alopecia, psoriasis, and folliculitis. However, the study faced challenges due to limited prior research, a lack of suitable datasets, and the diverse nature of images available online. To address these challenges, 9600 images were used for training and 1200 for testing, with preprocessing steps such as denoising, image equalization, enhancement, and data balancing to minimize the error rate. The preprocessed data was then fed into a convolutional neural network (CNN) model, resulting in an overall training accuracy of 99.2% and a validation accuracy of 98.1%.

articleTitle: Ensembled Deep Learning Technique for Cardiovascular Disease Detection: A CNN-GRU Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Innovative early diagnosis and intervention methods are needed to combat cardiovascular disease (CVD), the primary cause of death globally. In recent years, Deep Learning (DL) algorithms have become strong medical image analysis and clinical decision support tools. This presentation covers DL advances and applications in cardiovascular disease detection. Deep learning algorithms especially CNNs did well in medical imaging modalities like computed tomography, angiography, and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging. These algorithms extract features well, allowing accurate heart structure segmentation, abnormality identification, and function evaluation. DL-based methods may also identify subtle anatomical and pathological changes, aiding early diagnosis and risk assessment. Data quality, interpretability, and regulatory compliance must be addressed when using DL models in clinical practice. To assure the dependability and ethics of DL-based cardiovascular care solutions, explainable Artificial Intelligence (AI), federated learning and regulatory frameworks must improve model robustness, transparency and validation.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing based classifier for identifying spam emails and SMS messages
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: this research explores the development of a sophisticated classifier for screening spam emails and communications using Natural Language Processing (NLP). In today's digital age, where electronic communications continue to pour in, discriminating between beneficial and dangerous content is becoming increasingly important. The classifier uses NLP to analyze the intricacies of language used in Email/SMS and finds spam patterns. The classifier is trained on a dataset of both spam and non-spam messages using machine learning techniques, allowing it to reliably distinguish and categorize emails and SMS. This implementation's highest result for the Naïve Bayes Classifier is Bernoulli 0.98 percent. The goal is to improve the user experience by limiting exposure to irrelevant or potentially harmful content while assuring the seamless delivery of real communications.

articleTitle: Disease Identification in Potato Leaf using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the last few years, a part of artificial intelligence, which is deep learning, is in trend in various industries, including agriculture. It's a powerful tool that helps to extract important features, especially in tasks like identifying plant diseases. When it comes to recognizing plant diseases, deep learning is great because it removes the need for manually selecting features. This not only speeds up research and technological progress but also makes the process more objective. This review talks about the latest developments in deep learning technology for identifying diseases in crop leaves, and it also discusses the current trends and challenges in plant disease detection. I introduced a system that can classify two common potato diseases based on the condition of their leaves using deep learning models. Impressively, it achieves an accuracy rate of 97-98%. It's important to address the importance of early disease detection for sustainable agriculture and food security. The proposed leaf disease detection system uses deep learning models, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). In particular, this model for the identification of late blight and early blight shows exceptional accuracy, marking a significant advancement in managing crop diseases. Furthermore, we leverage artificial intelligence to improve the efficiency of leaf’s disease identification. These advancements in deep learning play a crucial role in promptly and effectively identifying plant diseases, ultimately enhancing crop production and quality.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach –Improved CNN Model for the Breast Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In spite of much Research breast cancer is the second dominant cause of death among women worldwide. About two out of eight women die due to breast cancer. To detect breast cancer disease, doctors use various techniques like mammography images, CT scans, etc. but these techniques are not significant for the pre-detection disease. Deep learning (DL) algorithms and their various models can make it easier to find out the disease by predicting it at the earliest stages. DL is playing a pivotal role in healthcare and medical sciences, this gave an innovation in this field. In this paper, ANN, CNN, and Improved CNN models are used for the prediction of breast cancer. This article works on the Non-IDC, and IDC, these are the types of cancer that are shown in the paper with 0 and 1. Improved CNN gave the highest accuracy out of the models. By increasing the features of the conv2D, max-pooling, flattened, and dense layers the parameter size is decreased by which the Improved CNN model performed better with 86% accuracy. The comparative analysis shows the achieved results by the models and also compares all the performance parameters by adding them and the accuracy of the model increases.

articleTitle: A Confirmation Based Accident Detection System Using IoT for Smart Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Accidents on the road continue to pose a significant threat to life and safety, necessitating innovative solutions to improve emergency response and minimize injuries. The proposed approach introduces an IoT-based Accident Detection System that integrates seamlessly with vehicle airbags, a confirmation button, GPS tracking, SOS calls, and a beeping system. The system harnesses a network of sensors to detect accidents accurately. When an accident occurs, it automatically deploys airbags to protect the passengers in the vehicle. A critical feature in the system is the manual confirmation button, which lets the occupants confirm the severity of the accident. If no confirmation is acquired within a set timeframe, the system proceeds to the next steps to save the occupant. The system uses GPS tracking with an accuracy of 96% to determine the location of the accident. Simultaneously, it initiates SOS calls to nearby hospitals and emergency services, ensuring seamless medical assistance. In addition, the system emits alerts to caution passersby and authorities about the accident.This system enhances emergency response, reducing the time between an accident occurring and medical attention. It not only minimizes injuries but also improves overall road safety. The proposed system aims to provide a brief overview of its multi-faceted capabilities, emphasizing its potential to save lives and reduce the severity of injuries in road accidents.

articleTitle: DNS DDoS Amplification Attack Detection Using Multi-Layer Perceptron Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks pose a significant threat to online services, particularly those targeting Domain Name System (DNS) amplification. This study investigates the effectiveness of a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifier for detecting DNS amplification attacks within network traffic data. The MLP employs three optimization techniques (ADAM, SGD, and LBFGS) and four activation functions (identity, logistic, Tanh, and ReLU) to optimize its performance. Feature selection utilizes Pearson correlation analysis to identify the most relevant features for attack detection. The DrDoS_ DNS dataset, derived from the CIC-DDoS2019 evaluation dataset, provides the network traffic data for this research. The results demonstrate that the MLP classifier with the ADAM optimization technique achieves the best classification accuracy for detecting DNS amplification attacks. Additionally, both Tanh and ReLU activation functions exhibit strong performance within the MLP model. These findings highlight the potential of machine learning techniques like MLPs for accurately identifying and mitigating DNS amplification DDoS attacks. Future research directions include exploring Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for feature extraction and potentially improving model performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Network Slicing Technology in the Collaborative Optimization of 4/5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the transition phase of coexistence between 4G and 5G networks during the early commercialization of 5G, achieving synergy and optimization between the two networks is an important issue. Based on the analysis of the ability of network slicing technology to achieve business differentiation isolation and QoS guarantee, this paper studies the characteristics of hybrid 4/5G network architecture, capacity evaluation models, and wireless resource optimization problems, and points out the challenges faced in optimizing the coordination performance of hybrid networks. On this basis, a network slicing-based collaborative approach for 4/5G networks is designed: using SDN controllers to uniformly schedule and manage multiple slice instances of 4G and 5G core networks, deploying traffic engineering to achieve slice-level business isolation and QoS mapping, and improving overall service performance through dynamic configuration of wireless resources, interference coordination based on SINR, and differentiated priority scheduling. Simulation results show that the proposed solution can significantly enhance the throughput and QoS of hybrid 4/5G networks, providing important insights into network optimization design and guiding network evolution strategies for 5G commercialization.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Forecasting and Disseminating Model for Connected Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the development of Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAV), there is a need to reduce the transit/delay time of vehicles on road. If the information about road scenario and traffic status is communicated before hand, then it would be easier for CAVs to plan their route so that they can reach the destination in minimum time. To accomplish this objective, the traffic needs to be predicted on the required location and at particular time. Also the predicted information should be disseminated to the neighboring CAVs. Deep Learning techniques, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long short-term memory (LSTM) are proposed in Traffic Flow Forecasting and Disseminating (TFFD) model for forecasting the traffic information. The information dissemination is proposed through Osmotic Computing (OC). The model has been validated using simulations that exhibit its viability.

articleTitle: Preventing Spoofing Threats in IoT: Machine Learning Approaches for Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The safety and reliability of Internet of Things (IoT) networks have to be guaranteed because of the quick spread of IoT devices. Significant risks to IoT deployments come from spoofing attacks, in which malevolent actors pretend to be trustworthy equipment to obtain illicit entry or interfere with normal operations. Utilizing the rich data supplied by an IoT intrusion detection dataset, this paper suggests a Machine Learning (ML)-based method for spotting spoofing attacks in IoT networks. In particular, investigate how well many ML algorithms such as Random Forests (RF), Naive Bayes (NB), Logistic Regression (LR), and Support Vector Machines (SVM) identify spoofing occurrences. Train and assess classifiers using supervised learning techniques on the IoT intrusion detection dataset, which includes various transmission patterns and instances of attack. After extensive testing and analysis, determine how well each algorithm performs in terms of F1-scoring, recall, precision, and detection accuracy. The findings demonstrate how effective ML techniques are in spotting spoofing attacks in IoT environments and highlight the potential of NB, LR, SVM, and RF as helpful tools for enhancing the safety posture of IoT deployments. These results provide useful information to cybersecurity experts and researchers working to lessen the risks of spoofing attacks in the IoT domain, as well as aiding in developing Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) for IoT environments.

articleTitle: Feline or Canine: A low computation cost CNN approach to image classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Image classification is a domain of Machine Learning, involving the techniques used to distinguish between images. Various parameters are taken into account such as pixel density, curves and edges, etc. There are various applications of Neural Networks but this paper will highlight the details of how to make a machine predict whether an image contains a dog or a cat with a low computation cost. The procedure is not complex but the functioning is indeed tangled into a complex network like architecture, that is training the model to classify an image as a dog or a cat with the training accuracy of 90% and validation accuracy of 89.30% along with very low loss 30%. Convolutional Neural Networks has become very popular in the modern day. As the hunt for artificial brain continues, the neural networks present best model for their implementation at present. The dataset include 25, 000 images with 6, 000 images for validation on trained model. In contrast, there exist pre-trained models like VGG16, VGG19, which is a very powerful model trained for image classification and object detection, consisting of 16 convolutional layers and 3 fully connected layers. Model proposed here is rather shallow, but also produce some great results in comparison to pre-trained models. As a performance parameter, accuracy and variance are used in the model evaluation.

articleTitle: Enhancing DNA Sequence Alignment using Ensemble Learning: A Voting Classifier and Stacking Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to improve pairwise DNA sequence alignment accuracy using ensemble learning techniques. The application of these methods has resulted in a remarkable accuracy of 94.5%. Utilizing the DNA sequence alignment datasets based on NW algorithm," we combine the outputs of multiple alignment algorithms through Voting Classifier and Stacking Ensemble methods to enhance alignment precision. This innovative approach leverages the collective power of diverse algorithms to generate consensus alignments that are more robust and biologically meaningful, addressing the limitations of individual methods and enabling researchers to gain more accurate insights into DNA sequence relationships and functional elements.

articleTitle: Email Spam Filteration with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Email spam has become a significant contemporary issue, mainly propelled by the rapid expansion of internet users. Correspondingly, the incidence of email spam is on the rise. These unsolicited communications serve as vehicles for nefarious and unethical purposes, including phishing and fraudulent activities. Using sophisticated techniques spammers create malicious links capable of compromising system security and infiltrating personal data. Crafting counterfeit profiles and email accounts is effortlessly achieved by spammers, enabling them to masquerade as genuine entities in their deceptive communications. Especially vulnerable individuals are unaware of such schemes, thus emphasizing the critical need to identify and mitigate such deceptive emails. This project aims to detect fraud email spam through the application of various machine learning algorithms. Numerous machine learning algorithms such as Naïve Bayes, SVMs, KNN & Decision Trees were used with specific datasets for this project. Integration has been done for the selection of the most effective algorithm for email spam detection as per definitive metric standards. Thus, our key findings indicate that Multinomial Naïve Bayes Algorithm is most suitable for spam filtration.

Author Keywords: random forest support vector machine-nearest neighbor

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Ventilation System Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Ventilation system is one of the important guarantees of mine safety production. Traditional ventilation system management mainly relies on manual experience and regular maintenance, which has the problems of low management efficiency, high maintenance cost and high safety risk. An intelligent ventilation system based on digital twin is proposed in this paper, which includes intelligent perception module, data processing module, digital twin module, intelligent decision-making module and emergency control module. The intelligent sensing module is used for data sensing and dynamic monitoring. the data processing module is used for carrying out centralized processing on the sensing data of the mine ventilation system. the digital twin module is used for constructing a three-dimensional simulation model of the ventilation system. the intelligent decision module is used for carrying out expert decision on a ventilation control scheme. The emergency control module is used for monitoring mine disaster information and formulating emergency control measures. In this paper, the digital twin model and data-driven of mine ventilation system are constructed. According to the optimized intelligent control scheme, the reliability of intelligent control of mine ventilation system using digital twin technology is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential of EEG: Convolutional Neural Networks for ADHD Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: High-resolution electroencephalogram (EEG) and functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI), combined with advanced computational neuroscience and machine learning methods, are remaking the way that ADHD diagnostics are approached. This integration can resolve a difficulty in diagnosis of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder ( ADHD) which is as complex of an issue due to the deep repercussions for the lives it affects. Further, the combined application of EEG and fMRI as diagnostic tools has triggered new understanding in neurobiology what is going on with this devastating disorder. The accuracy rate is impressive and closes to 94%, respectively in referred studies. Research has shown that by using such tools for early detection and accurate diagnosis, patient outcomes are significantly improved. In addition, big data analysis and cloud computing are revolutionizing the field of ADHD diagnostics. This real-time analysis of data not only makes high-precision diagnosis available anywhere in the world, it also transforms it into a tool for collaborative research. With such broad and diverse data sets as well as the participation of so many varieties of experts, it will be possible to refine our current models and develop more advanced diagnostic techniques in future. This new vision of the landscape of diagnostic technologies in ADHD foresees not only dynamic though rapid developments but also a future where digital health solutions form an integral and coherent part with clinical care services for hundreds of millions people affected by ADHD around the world.

articleTitle: Segment Anything Model (SAM) to Segment lymphocyte from Blood Smear Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Automated lymphocyte segmentation from smear images plays an important role in disease diagnosis and monitoring, aiding in the assessment of immune system function and pathology detection. This study proposes an approach for lymphocyte segmentation utilizing Segment Anything Model (SAM) which is a deep learning model. Our method leverages a pre trained SAM architecture and fine-tunes it on a custom dataset comprising smear images containing lymphocytes. The pretrained model’s ability of versatile segmentation combined with fine-tuning on the specific dataset enhances its performance in accurately identifying lymphocyte boundaries. We evaluate the proposed approach on a diverse set of smear images, demonstrating its effectiveness in segmenting lymphocytes with impressive IOU score and Dice Score. SAM deep learning model, fine-tuned on custom datasets, holds promise for robust and efficient lymphocyte segmentation from blood smear images.

articleTitle: From Pixels to Insights: Transforming Plant Pathology with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: We urgently want more precise methods of detecting plant diseases because they pose an increasing danger to the global food supply. Finding a solution to this challenge utilising state-of-the-art deep learning technology is the focus of this research. Various models' abilities to diagnose plant diseases are examined in the study. Squeezenet1_1, VGG13, Inception_v3, ResNet34, DenseNet169, and AlexNet are among the models it examines. Included in the data set is a background class from the DAGS dataset in addition to 38 distinct plant diseases culled from the PlantVillage dataset on Kaggle. The results demonstrate that various designs and training methods exhibit slight variations in performance. For instance, after extensive retraining, AlexNet achieves an accuracy of 99.24%. However, after extensive retraining, DenseNet169 achieves an impressive 99.72% accuracy. In order to have a deeper grasp of the models' behaviour, the research incorporates visualisation experiments with accuracy measurements. In the occlusion experiment, we can see heat maps that graphically depict how various picture elements impact the program's decision-making. In order to determine which pixels are most relevant, the saliency map experiment use mathematics. This sheds light on the decision-making process of the model. Utilising AlexNet and VGG13, pictures of specific plant diseases such as Septoria Leaf Spot, Early Blight, and Late Blight are displayed. To summarise, this article discusses the inner workings of various deep learning models for plant disease detection and compares them. The findings aid in selecting optimal models and training strategies, which in turn facilitates the development of robust and reliable automated systems for disease diagnosis in plants. Using cutting-edge technologies, this study represents a major step towards improving agricultural disease detection.

articleTitle: Hesitant Bi-Fuzzy VIKOR method for Green Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Hesitant bifuzzy sets (HBFSs) plays an important role to deal with uncertainties and vagueness. These uncertainties may be accurately and perfectly characterised in terms of the decision-makers’ viewpoint. In decision making, the alternatives are evaluated on the basis of different criteria depending upon the nature of problem. This article aims to develop a VIKOR method with hesitant bifuzzy information. Distance measure plays a crucial role in decision making, cluster analysis, medical diagnosis and pattern recognition. In this article, a novel distance measure of HBFS has been developed. The information in daily life may be biased or uncertain in nature, therefore it is important to highlight the significance of each aspect/criterion. To deal with this situation, weighted measures have been defined in this study. These proposed measures are used to describe the hesitant bifuzzy VIKOR method to solve multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) problem. To demonstrate the applicability of developed method in real life situation, an illustrative example of Green supply chain management has been taken.

articleTitle: Using Geometric Constraints in Robot Kinematics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Solving the kinematic equations is a fundamental challenge in the study of motion, workspace, trajectory and path planning, control strategies, loadings distribution, torque capacity, inertia, energy consumption, kinematic performances, calibration, understanding the design, influence in manufacturing, collision detection, interactivity, and the best solutions in software for articulated robot. The modern CAD applications can help engineers to solve much faster all these problems presented at the top list. This study presents advanced research using geometric constraints in solving Inverse, Forward Kinematics, and Workspace assessment problems of a robot based on SOLIDWORKS CAD software with all its capabilities including programming skills with SOLIDWORKS API. Kinematic constraints should be used in a specific manner that complies with the real robot movements at any required robot position.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Transfer Learning Models for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a significant health issue that leads to a high number of deaths in women worldwide. A successful course of therapy and better patient outcomes depend on early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer. Deep learning methodologies, specifically transfer learning, have recently been widely used in medical image analysis. This study investigates the comparative effectiveness of various transfer learning models for breast cancer detection. Five pre-trained models, namely VGG19, ResNet50, EfficientNetB4, MobileNetV2, and InceptionV3 are compared. These models are fine-tuned on a breast cancer image dataset comprising breast ultrasound scans. Their performances for 3-class classification are evaluated using seven metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, support, AUC, and loss. This comparative analysis will help researchers and healthcare professionals choose the best transfer learning model for breast cancer detection by revealing their strengths and weaknesses.

articleTitle: Approaches for Identifying Suicide Ideation in Social Media Texts: Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In contemporary society, Suicide has become a notable concern within the realm of public health. Suicidal ideation (SI) encompasses thoughts about ending one's life. Factors contributing to suicidal thoughts and actions are diverse, ranging from personal life events to enduring emotional distress. We investigate the issue of identifying such ideation on Twitter, emphasizing the usefulness of a collection of characteristics taken from the literature as well as the function of discussion context in this process. Numerous machine learning algorithms have been put forth to identify SI from internet channels, but because feature engineering and classification techniques are still lacking, the accuracy of these algorithms is still low. Therefore, by using novel deep learning and natural language processing-based feature engineering technique accuracy can be increased.

articleTitle: RedRot and Mosaic Sugarcane Leaf Disease Classification using an EfficientNet Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Sugarcane leaf diseases significantly impact crop productivity and challenge global sugar production. In this study, we employ EfficientNet, a state-of-the-art convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, for the automated classification of sugarcane leaf diseases. Leveraging transfer learning and fine-tuning techniques, we adapt the pre-trained EfficientNet model to accurately identify common leaf diseases such as rust, smut, and leaf scald. Our model achieves a remarkable accuracy of 94.60% on the test dataset, indicating its efficacy in distinguishing between different sugarcane leaf diseases. Additionally, the test loss value of 0.7834 underscores the model’s robustness and generalization capability in accurately classifying unseen sugarcane leaf images. Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of EfficientNet in automated disease diagnosis, offering a promising solution for the rapid and objective assessment of crop health. These findings hold significant implications for agricultural practices, enabling timely interventions and targeted disease management strategies to mitigate yield losses and ensure sustainable sugarcane production. By integrating advanced technologies such as EfficientNet with agricultural practices, we aim to empower farmers and stakeholders with the tools and insights needed to safeguard crop health and enhance agricultural sustainability in the face of evolving challenges.

articleTitle: Abstractive Text Summarization using Transformer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The internet has large amounts of textual data which has become a double-edged sword. The information is always available but due to its high volume it is hard to find the things which we are looking for. In the past, subject experts were used to create comprehensions which was very time consuming and not financially viable. These comprehensions were made by reading lengthy texts, but often gave redundant results when working on similar articles. To address this problem, Automatic Text Summarization can be used. It helps in generating concise summaries using information retrieval by capturing the document’s essence which makes it easier for users to find the key points from the original text. Imagine quickly grasping an article’s core message before deciding on a deeper dive. This efficiency is invaluable in today’s information-driven world. This paper proposes an advanced “abstractive” text summarization system that delves deeper than simply extracting key sentences. By leveraging Natural Language Processing techniques, the system analyses the text’s structure, identifies salient points, and grasps their relationships. By comprehending the underlying context and logic, the system generates summaries using novel phrasings that accurately reflect the content, paving the way for a revolution in information navigation.

articleTitle: Systematic Matrix-Oriented Diffusion for Wireless Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: To enhance wireless detection systems, the study suggests using the Matrix-Oriented Diffusion (MOD) technique. This is accomplished by lowering node energy consumption through the use of a matrix-based diffusion mechanism. MOD prioritizes the optimization of energy utilization in wireless detection systems to extend the system’s lifespan and improve overall performance. Small clusters of nodes are formed and created on a virtual matrix built with routing fidelity in mind. This configuration enables the efficient dissemination of information within clusters, resulting in decreased energy usage. The virtual matrix enables the effective and efficient distribution of knowledge among clusters, reducing energy consumption and enhancing system efficiency. Clusters in MOD are utilized for the management of substantial quantities of data produced by sensing nodes. This strategy facilitates expedited processing and diminishes energy use by allocating jobs among members of a cluster. The process of grouping nodes into clusters makes it possible to manage data floods more effectively, hence lowering the workload on specific nodes and enhancing the overall performance of the system. In summary, the MOD technique provides a systematic approach to energy-efficient data dissemination in wireless detection systems, resulting in enhanced performance and prolonged system longevity. The MOD approach enhances the efficiency of the WDS by strategically positioning nodes, resulting in less energy loss. The MOD approach employs clusters to achieve the substantial volumes of information generated by the detecting nodes. This could lead to faster management speeds and reduced power use.

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Fundus Diseases can lead to deterioration of the patient’s eyesight or even complete loss of vision in extreme cases. Hence it becomes imperative to detect such debilitating diseases at the earliest. Diabetic Retinopathy, Glaucoma, Retinal Detachment, and other serious diseases come under Fundus Diseases. Put briefly, Diabetic Retinopathy is the prevalent microvascular complication, occurring due to an outstanding history of diabetes mellitus. General survey of the Indian consensus suggests an increase in such diseases where the condition of the eye degenerates, in the recent past. Researchers have devised various techniques for the detection and prevention of Fundus Diseases, by making use of Deep Learning and Machine Learning concepts. The following study is an example of the same, while focusing on building Deep Learning models to detect Diabetic Retinopathy. It was carried out in collaboration with Ophthalmologists, who have provided the dataset required for this study, which is around 700 images after being subjected to certain augmentation techniques. Deep Learning models have been used to differentiate between fundus images of patients with and without Diabetic Retinopathy. Some custom-made models and some pre-trained models were used for this study. Further, the models are compared based on certain performance metrics and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Fruits And Vegetables Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this study, a system is developed to improve the methods and processes of identifying fruits and vegetable by both farmers and a normal human, this research tends to provide an approach for identification or classification of fruits and vegetables through a deep learning method that is known as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in more reliable and faster way. The CNN architecture is used to train a model for different features of an image that is provided in the dataset and hence classify what fruit or vegetable it is. This model is trained on a dataset, containing various images of 36 different fruits and vegetables. This model showcases an accuracy rate of 95.15%.

articleTitle: Exploring Data Security Issues in the Wake of Internet of Things (IoT) Adoption in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: as the adoption of the internet of things (IoT) turns into an increasing number of widely wide-spread in deliver chain management, concerns approximately facts security have additionally risen. This technical abstract explores a number of the key data security issues that organizations should not forget whilst imposing IoT in supply chain management.one of the primary worries with IoT in deliver chain control is the vulnerability of connected devices to cyber assaults. As extra devices are related to the internet and every other, it creates a larger assault surface for hackers to exploit. This will bring about touchy deliver chain records being compromised, leading to financial losses and reputational harm for companies. Some other key issue is the gathering and storage of massive amounts of information from IoT devices. This facts contains touchy statistics together with product and purchaser information, provider records, and logistics statistics. It is critical for organizations to have proper information control and garage protocols in vicinity to shield these facts from cyber threats.

articleTitle: Analyzing Sentiments with Machine Learning and Deep Learning through Word Embedding Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis involves deciphering contextual sentiments from textual data, which may originate from various sources such as social media posts, comments, reviews, blogs, tweets, and news articles. This process begins with text preprocessing techniques like stop word removal, lemmatization, and stemming, preparing the text for further analysis. Subsequently, the preprocessed text undergoes transformation into vectors via word embedding techniques, facilitating the application of machine learning and neural network methodologies. Among these, Word2vec and Skip-gram have emerged as effective supervised learning techniques, while GLoVe stands out in the unsupervised learning domain. Additionally, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) represent the deep learning approaches for analyzing textual data. This paper delves into how these machine learning and deep learning algorithms, applied within word embedding frameworks, can be instrumental in extracting features. These features can then be classified into positive, negative, or neutral sentiments, offering insights into the moral and ethical perspectives of individuals across various sectors, including business, politics, e-commerce, healthcare, and film reviews. Our findings indicate that deep learning methods surpass traditional machine learning in accuracy and effectiveness in predicting sentiments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Solar Panel Management using VGG16 and Accessing Early Damage Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This work looks at developing and evaluating a deep learning-based approach for early surface impurity and damage detection on solar panels, including dust, snow, bird droppings, physical damage, and electrical damage. Eighty-seven images in all from the collection are divided into six categories: clean, dusty, bird drop, electrical damage, physical damage, and snow-covered. The work uses and obtains access to the VGG16 model to investigate how well the transfer learning model does in accurately recognising these photographs. Early identification of such issues is essential to preserving optimum solar panel efficiency, reducing societal maintenance costs, and reducing resource consumption. Modern Deep Learning algorithms are used in the proposed technique to examine the images and classify them. The findings show that the suggested method is effective in identifying and categorising surface issues on solar panels, which can result in higher energy output and sustainability. With 92.7% accuracy and precision rate, the gathered data is impressive.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Prediction Using Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Lung Cancer poses a serious health danger worldwide. distinguish by its highest mortality rate. It mainly occurs due to exposure to air pollution and radon gases. This research works the diverse Deep Learning (DL) models to detect the disease timely, referred to as VGG16, InceptionV3, and EfficientB0. Early prediction of lung cancer is effective in treatment and it can also decrease the death rate. Each algorithm exploits distinct layers such as convolutional layers, max-pooling, ReLu function, Dense blocks, and Softmax activation function to make the output more reliable and efficient. EfficientNetB0 has different scaling abilities to train the model which is why this model performed better than other models with 93% accuracy and a minimal loss of 0.234. This study intends to highlight the effectiveness of DL models in forecasting disease and also describe the uniqueness of the DL models by using its Deep Neural Networks, emphasized as one of the practical issues for implementing DL models in clinical settings, informed permission, algorithm openness, and patient privacy are discussed from an ethical perspective as well, highlighting the necessity of responsible AI use in medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Early Warning of Shared Financial Management Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the context of the increasing complexity of financial markets, an efficient and accurate financial early warning system has become particularly crucial for achieving effective shared financial management. To optimize financial management warning, this article proposes a financial early warning model based on neural networks, which can overcome the problems of response delay and insufficient accuracy in traditional early warning methods. This article integrates deep learning techniques, particularly utilizing the architecture of convolutional neural networks to process and analyze time series data, in order to successfully identify dynamic and potential risk patterns in financial data. The model is optimized through cross validation and regularization strategies, ensuring its adaptability to new data and good stability performance. The research results clearly indicate that the stability of the model in this study exceeded 97%. Compared to traditional systems, the model proposed in this article has achieved significant improvements in both early warning and accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetes using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)

authors.preferredName: M V B Murali Krishna M

abstract: In this work, we utilize machine learning to build a diabetes risk prediction model which is uniquely suited to a dataset of only females. The dataset focuses on important health measurements of women, such as the frequency of pregnancies and blood tests for insulin and glucose. We develop a Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm using NumPy, Pandas, and other Python packages. SVM is a good fit for the complex interplay of factors in diabetes risk prediction because of its ability to handle high-dimensional datasets and non-linear interactions. The approach uses historical data to train our SVM model, which enables the computer identify the patterns and correlations inside the dataset. Through the identification of minor associations between physiological indicators and pregnancy history, the model gains proficiency in forecasting the probability of developing diabetes.

articleTitle: Employing XGBoost Algorithm for Accurate Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease and its Risk Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) cause major morbidity and mortality worldwide. Improved patient outcomes and lower healthcare costs depend on early CVD prediction and identification. Recent advances in Machine Learning (ML) have made it possible to analyze complex medical data and identify CVD risk factors. This paper covers ML applications in cardiovascular health, including risk assessment, early diagnosis, predictive analytics, remote monitoring, and treatment optimization. The authors discuss how ML algorithms use large datasets of demographics, medical history, lifestyle factors, biomarkers, and medical imaging data to generate personalized risk assessments and detect early CVD abnormalities. The authors also demonstrate how ML models can analyze wearable device physiological data to evaluate cardiovascular health in real-time. The authors also examine how ML-driven predictive analytics might predict future cardiovascular events and help healthcare practitioners develop focused therapies and preventive measures. The authors also analyze big clinical datasets to determine optimal medication selection, dose modifications, and therapy monitoring regimens using ML algorithms for CVD treatment. This review shows how ML improves CVD prediction and detection, improving patient outcomes and healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning Architectures for Enhanced Traffic Sign Recognition: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research paper investigates the efficacy of various deep learning architectures in Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) tasks, aiming to contribute to the advancement of intelligent transportation systems. A comprehensive comparative analysis is conducted, evaluating the performance of four prominent architectures: AlexNet, DenseNet, VGG, and a generic CNN, using the GTSRB dataset. Results demonstrate that DenseNet achieves the highest accuracy of 95.12%, outperforming other architectures, with remarkable precision, recall, and F1-score values. The generic CNN also exhibits impressive performance, with an accuracy of 97.31% and comparable metrics. Conversely, AlexNet and VGG achieve accuracies of 88.84% and 85.03%, respectively, with varying performance metrics. These findings underscore the effectiveness of DenseNet and the generic CNN in accurately classifying traffic signs, highlighting their potential for real-world implementation. The study emphasizes the importance of selecting appropriate deep learning architectures tailored to specific tasks, and further analysis may explore strategies to optimize model performance and generalization capability.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection in Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The increasing use of cloud computing has also resulted in a higher vulnerability to cyber attacks. Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) play a vital role in protecting cloud computing environments from these attacks. However, the unique characteristics of cloud computing, such as its dynamic and distributed nature, pose challenges for traditional NIDS. This paper provides an overview of the current state of NIDS in cloud computing environments, including their limitations and potential solutions. It also discusses the use of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques in improving NIDS performance. The effectiveness of NIDS in detecting both known and unknown attacks is crucial for the security of cloud computing environments and requires continuous research and development.

articleTitle: Securing Birth Certifications using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Blockchain has been recognized as a secure technology with which unique and tamper-proof certificates can be issued. Today the secure and immutable storage of vital records, such as birth certificates, is of paramount importance. Traditional systems for recording and managing such documents are complex, tedious, and inaccessible for many. At present, issuing a certificate involves three stakeholders; Parents, Hospitals, and Registrars. The Parents must visit the Registrar and report the birth after which the Registrar verifies the birth, which is a time-intensive process for the Registrar. To address these challenges, we present a web application that leverages blockchain technology to record and manage birth certificates. By utilizing a decentralized and distributed ledger, our application improves accessibility, transparency, and increased security. This paper outlines the design, implementation, and evaluation of our birth certificate recording system, highlighting its benefits for hospitals, registrars, and individuals. Furthermore, limitations and the future work of this technology are discussed.

articleTitle: Audio Insight: Audio Stream Context Recognition, Intent and Entity Classification using SNIPS NLU and SMER Named Entity Recognizer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Understanding of conversational context by software and machines is of utmost importance for the growing need for Artificial Intelligence interfaces, facilitating effective human-machine communication. This need grows exponentially when dealing with the medical domain, having machines respond faster and accurately to medical use cases is crucial. The research, hence, rigorously analyzes the performance of the SNIPS NLU engine along with our novel SMER (SciSpacy and Med7 based NER) Medical Named Entity Recognizer. The research then furnishes a mechanism to understand patient complaints and provides prompt results based on the retrieved information. Specifically, the study involves using the SNIPS NLU for context classification and SMER for information retrieval in an ensemble approach to provide an Intent classification (NLU) accuracy of 94% and Entity accuracy of (SMER) 86.95%, thus posing as a pivotal benchmark in advancing machine proficiency for finding context from audios. The proposed mechanism, thereafter, can be used in situations involving booking medicines, procedures, appointments, and more.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Intelligent Interior Design Algorithms Based on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the past few decades, interior design has relied on manual experience and designer intuition, during which time was consumed and the design results often failed to meet customer needs. Intelligent interior design is an emerging field based on artificial intelligence and big data technology, which aims to provide efficient and personalized interior design solutions through intelligent algorithms and data analysis. Therefore, this article's research on the application of intelligent design in indoor space has great practical significance and practical value. In this article, artificial intelligence and big data technology and their expansion of intelligent algorithms are analyzed with emphasis, and experiments and performance comparisons of several algorithms related to interior design are conducted. This article uses an interactive method to compare the running time of genetic algorithms, evolutionary algorithms and differential evolution algorithms. Experimental results show that the interactive evolutionary algorithm takes 56.2ms and the interactive genetic algorithm takes 33.6ms.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring System of Elderly Health Based on Smote Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the increasing trend of the aging of society, the diseases of the elderly show a gradually increasing trend, which has a certain degree of impact on the family and society. In order to improve the health and quality of life of the elderly, a new solution based on infrared sensor technology is proposed in this paper. In this paper, infrared pyroelectric sensor module and ultrasonic ranging principle are used to realize the health monitoring function of the elderly. After that, the paper tested the intelligent monitoring system, and the test results showed that the accuracy of heart rate and blood pressure monitoring changed over time. In the initial stage, the accuracy of heart rate monitoring was 0.85, and gradually improved after a period of observation, eventually reaching 0.90. The system also has the characteristics of convenience and ease of use, so that the elderly can easily carry out health monitoring.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Neural Networks and Deep Learning Techniques for Enhancing Precision in Agricultural Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: As we know, India is primarily known for its farming practices. More than 50% of the total land is used for agriculture. The selection of land depends on the type of soil, climate conditions, and irrigation facilities. Agricultural methods have been used since 9000 BCE in northwest India, but traditional methods no longer adequately fulfill the needs due to population increase and adverse atmospheric conditions. There is a need to create a sustainable production system to meet our needs. The most advanced machine learning technology, known as deep learning (DL), excels in decision-making, computer vision, bioinformatics, natural language processing, and other fields. In this paper, we study how various deep learning algorithms can assist in predicting yields or any decision-making process. This paper implemented and compared various machine learning and deep learning algorithms to check the better precision of algorithms such as Decision Tree gives accuracy of 73.152%, Navies Bayes 49.020%, Random Forest 66.673%, k-nearest neighbors algorithm has 37. 581% and Support vector machine has 78.924% accuracy. Along with the comparison of algorithms with accuracies, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) are also compared.

articleTitle: The Application of Blockchain Technology in Digital Electronic File Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Digital electronic file is a new technology, it is based on graphics, text and other data, and all kinds of information analysis and storage. In the future, more and more people will participate in the construction of digital archives. This paper starts from the principle of blockchain, studies its management process and application status; at the same time, combined with the actual situation, this paper puts forward the use of block chain technology to build a file sharing mechanism based on block chain technology and establish a perfect database system. Finally, the performance of this model is tested and analyzed, and the test results show that resource utilization peaks between 0-2 and 6-8, and declines between 3-5 and 9-10. By monitoring this dynamic change, it is possible to assess the efficiency of resources and make informed decisions for resource allocation and optimization. In order for the system to always operate efficiently, it is necessary to adjust the rational allocation of resources according to these monitoring results to ensure that resources can be used to the maximum during the peak period, and to reduce the waste of resources and improve the efficiency of resource use during the trough period.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Anti Web Crawler Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper provides an anti-crawler framework for web. It proposes two key strategies, active defense and passive defense. Active defense emphasizes identifying and intercepting web crawlers while passive defense focuses on upgrading pages to prevent web crawler programs from obtaining data. The key to actively rejecting lies in identifying crawlers. In this regard, the focus is on the difference between web crawlers and browsers. The two use different User Agents, Cookies, and network signatures. Configuration auxiliary files on the server side can be used to detect this information, identify crawlers, and deny their access. In addition, monitor the access frequency of each user on the server side, and if the access frequency is too high, the service will be automatically denied. Passive anti crawler strategy mainly depend on upgrading web pages. Confusing text in web pages increases the difficulty of web content recognition by web crawlers. At the same time, encode and encrypt important data. Practice has proven that the proposed network anti crawler framework is highly scientific and effective, which can improve the recognition rate of crawler programs and the ability to anti crawler mechanisms.

articleTitle: Image Analysis and Machine Learning for Anemia Detection via Nails
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Anemia, characterized by a deficiency in healthy blood, poses a significant health challenge globally. While historical diagnosis relied on visual cues like paleness and fatigue, contemporary approaches integrate state-of-the-art technology with traditional knowledge. In addressing this issue, our initiative employs advanced image analysis and machine learning techniques to swiftly identify anemia from nail photos, preserving conventional diagnostic methods while enhancing accuracy. While others focus on traditional diagnostic methods, our approach harnesses the power of image analysis and machine learning to detect anemia early through nail color and shape analysis. Prioritizing ethical considerations, particularly data privacy, guides our methodology. Additionally, we engage the public to illuminate ethical concerns surrounding medical image analysis. Preliminary results demonstrate promising outcomes, with our machine learning model achieving an accuracy rate of 90% in identifying anemia from nail photos. Early detection holds significant benefits, including cost savings, improved quality of life, and timely treatment, ultimately enhancing vitality, productivity, and well-being across demographics and geographic locations. To comprehensively address anemia, a multifaceted strategy integrating public awareness campaigns, healthcare interventions, and continued research is imperative. In conclusion, our initiative not only pays homage to historical diagnostic practices but also paves the way for an ethically driven future where technology enhances healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Using CNN-DT Model to Classify Indian Cauliflower Varieties in New Ways
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Improving farming relies on correctly sorting crop types. This research introduces a new way to classify different types of cauliflower in India. It uses something called Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Decision Trees (DT). The dataset comprises four distinct cauliflower varieties prevalent in India: Pusa Deepali, Pusa Snowball K-1, and Pusa Meghna are types of snowball. Strict data cleaning made the datasets more equal and added variety. The CNN-DT model is very good. It has a high 96.7% total correctness in sorting these types into their proper categories without mistakes. Looking at it in recent ways shows that this model is better than others in being accurate and working well. It's a big step forward for categorizing types of plants. The mixed model not only does well in getting things right but also allows clear choices to be made. This is important for farming uses. We use CNNs and DT together to understand important differences between cauliflower types. This helps us see how they look different from each other. This study shows ways for farm technology, to help people to manage crops better with useful information. The model shows amazing precision and easy understanding, but future improvements will focus on fixing the problem of different amounts in classes. It also needs to add more variety to its information. In the end, this study creates a new way to classify cauliflower types. It will help make farming better with new ideas and improve how we manage crops more efficiently.

articleTitle: Optimising Pharmaceutical Sales and Marketing with Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: It is essential to analyse pharmaceutical sales through a data analysis tool in order to enhance new sales and marketing strategies. The research is based on background studies related to market analysis, sales data, and competition, as well as patient demographics. The paper checks the performance of the sales team, whether salesmen follow rules, and what sales are likely to happen in the future considering past data. Further, marketing strategies that enhance product and consumer satisfaction demand an adjudicated evaluation. These insights are vital for efficient resource application and nurturing corporate growth. The findings of this study may eventually make a real change in the way clinical research and strategic decision-making are considered by the pharmaceutical industry.

articleTitle: Reviewlogy: An Interface for Analyzing Sentiments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of early reviews on product sales by analyzing the traits of initial reviewers on major e-commerce platforms. It segments product life-cycles into three phases: early, majority, and laggards, focusing on early reviewers who post reviews during the initial stages. The paper introduces an innovative interface for sentiment analysis to identify and predict early reviewers. Quantitative analysis reveals that early reviewers often provide more insightful comments and give higher overall ratings. Their ratings and helpfulness scores significantly affect product popularity. The methodology, tested on extensive datasets from Amazon and Yelp, extracts crucial attributes of early reviewers, including purchasing patterns and social impact. The interface employs a hybrid machine learning approach combining Naive Bayes, margin-based embedding ranking models (MERM), and support vector machines (SVMs) to predict potential early reviewers accurately. This approach balances probabilistic reasoning with robust classification, ensuring comprehensive forecasting. Evaluation metrics such as precision and accuracy demonstrate the effectiveness of the models over baseline methods. Furthermore, the study enhances the understanding of how early reviews influence consumer behavior and product success in e-commerce. The interface aids in refining product marketing strategies by enabling precise targeting of early reviewers, accelerating product adoption, amplifying sales, and optimizing marketing tactics in the competitive e-commerce landscape.

articleTitle: Object Classification For Autonomous Vehicles using a One-stage Detector Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Object detection is crucial for the reliability of autonomous driving and vehicle safety systems, particularly under diverse environmental conditions. This study evaluates the YOLOv7 object detection algorithm within the context of autonomous driving using the Berkeley Deep Drive (BDD100K) dataset. The evaluation focuses on key metrics such as accuracy, computation time, and precision-recall curves to assess YOLOv7’s performance in real-time scenarios. The findings highlight YOLOv7’s robustness in detecting objects efficiently, yet reveal challenges in extreme weather conditions and complex environments. This comprehensive analysis underscores the algorithm’s strengths and limitations, providing insights into its applicability and areas for further enhancement in autonomous driving systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Credit Card Fraud detection using Extra Tree Classifier and Data Balancing Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the digital finance age, increased credit card transactions have led to a rise in fraudulent activities. This study employs machine learning to detect fraud in unbalanced European credit card data. Techniques like SMOTE and Cluster Centroids are utilized for data balancing. Algorithms including Extra Trees, XGBoost, and K-Nearest Neighbors are evaluated using metrics such as accuracy and F1 score. The results show significant improvements, especially with the Extra Trees classifier, emphasizing the method's effectiveness in securing online financial transactions.

articleTitle: Rail Transit Logistics Distribution on Basis of Computer-Aided Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Nowadays, the operational efficiency of rail transit logistics distribution is low, and the distribution cost is high. For this purpose, this article carried out CAS design, and the vehicle scheduler used scheduling algorithms to generate the optimal scheduling plan based on job and vehicle conditions; Real time monitoring is the use of global positioning systems and sensors to monitor the position and condition of vehicles in real time. The real-time monitoring module can ensure the transportation safety of goods. This article uses different datasets and evaluation indicators to compare the advantages and disadvantages of intelligent path planning and traditional manual route selection methods in terms of delivery efficiency, time, and cost. The delivery efficiency of Method 1 (intelligent path planning+dataset A) is 120 times/hour, with an average delivery time of 28 minutes and an average cost of 150 yuan; The delivery efficiency of Method 2 (manual route selection+dataset A) is 90 times/hour, with an average delivery time of 35 minutes and an average cost of 180 yuan. This article focuses on the research of rail transit logistics distribution based on computer-aided systems (CAS), which helps to improve distribution efficiency and reduce distribution costs.

articleTitle: Mining of Information Association Rules for Construction Safety Accidents Using Fuzzy Algorithms and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of data analysis of construction safety accident information and achieve the mining of information association rules for construction safety accidents, this paper used fuzzy clustering algorithm and association rule mining method to analyze the characteristics of construction safety accidents, and verified the mining results, thereby achieving the mining of information association rules for construction safety accidents. Through research, it has been found that the causes of safety accidents are complex, and data mining techniques can be used to obtain some effective information. Through the analysis of the results of fuzzy clustering algorithms and association rule mining, it was found that the confidence level reached over 86.9%. At the same time, this article proposed suggestions for using fuzzy clustering algorithm to mine association rules for safety accident management, and proposed measures to strengthen construction safety management from four aspects: personnel, equipment, environment, and management, providing a scientific and effective management decision-making platform for construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Dual-Axis Solar Tracking System for Enhanced Energy Utilization in Grid-Tied Systems With Net-Metering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This document presents a study on the execution of a dual-axis solar tracking system to optimize solar energy utilization in grid-tied systems with net metering. The paper aims to address the increasing need for sustainable energy solutions by enhancing solar power generation efficiency. The research gap identified lies in the limited daylight utilization of fixed solar panels, prompting the development of a dual-axis tracking system for improved power generation. The methodology involves building a physical dual-axis solar tracker using Arduino, comparing its performance with standard panels, and simulating the grid and net meter in MATLAB Simulink. Results indicate that dual-axis trackers outperform standard panels, leading to reduced electricity bills and a more efficient grid-tied system. The key message highlights the benefits of dual-axis trackers in decreasing payback periods and promoting sustainable energy usage. This research contributes to advancing solar energy utilization and supports efforts towards carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: The Smart Banking Automation for High Rated Financial Transactions using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The banking enterprise is constantly evolving, and with the upward thrust of the era, there is a growing call for faster and more comfortable financial transactions. So one can meet the demands of excessively rated financial transactions, deep mastering generation is being applied to expand an intelligent banking automation gadget. This device uses advanced artificial intelligence techniques, including deep learning algorithms, to analyze and examine statistics from various financial assets in real time. It can discover anomalies in monetary transactions and flag them for further research, reducing the hazard of fraudulent activities. The clever banking automation machine additionally allows for faster processing of excessively rated monetary transactions, ensuring well-timed and accurate budget transfers. It can also assist with choice-making by providing predictive analytics primarily based on financial information.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Batch Arrival of Tasks in Cloud Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Assuring the quality of service (QoS) criteria requires accurate performance measurement of cloud computing resources. This article is concerned with the performance evaluation of an infinite buffer capacity batch arrival multi-server queueing system with geometric distribution, deterministic distribution, and truncated Poisson distribution of the batch sizes. The steady-state approach is used and solved the recursive equations. In addition, various performance parameters of the queueing model are derived. Finally, using different numerical illustrations the impact of different parameters on strategies has been studied.

articleTitle: Life Expectancy Prediction using Machine Learning Technique – KNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In the modern world, life expectancy turns out to be the most valuable factor in determining population’s health. Today, it is more crucial to predict the future because life is more precarious due to a variety of circumstances, including social, economic, environmental, educational, lifestyle, and health conditions. The machine learning algorithm KNN for life expectancy is presented in this work. The dataset gathered for this study is separated into a training set (70%) and a test set (30%), and the forecasts precision is examined. To avoid misclassification, KNN needs a larger sample size, and the best K are chosen more in accordance with cross-validation experience than with strong statistical theory.

articleTitle: Optimization of Community Detection Using Layered Degree Gravity in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Network analysis is necessary to understand the structure and dynamics of complex systems. In this study, we use the Louvain algorithm for community detection in networks and examine the effect of seed size on centrality measures. We create an evidence-based representation and use the Louvain algorithm to identify communities in the network. To analyze the mean, we developed a method to calculate the mean score of affected seeds based on different seed set (k). Our experimental results show the impact of small nodes on central parameters such as mean and closeness, providing insight into good strategies for the selection of analysis in the network. This work helps improve our understanding of community structure and key nodes in complex networks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lung Cancer Prediction: A Dual-Class Classification Approach with CNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this research follows a completely different way of identifying lung cancer: a hybrid model combining Support Vector Machines (SVMs) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Thus, the traditional lung X-ray and the CT scan pictures can be divided into two categories using a trained model: healthy ("Well") and disease and the disease condition is called "Sick." A combination of data from SVHN and CT Medical Image Database significantly improves predictive accuracy across large numbers of images. Hybrid CNN-SVM achieves very good results in telling clearly that different tissues are either healthy or sick. Good precision 93.68%, recall 94.41%. These results say a good deal about the model's ability to give true answers – or diagnoses, healthy ones but it will have many applications for future diagnosis and tailor-made treatment strategies. An innovative combination of imaging methods as well as rapid machine-learning algorithms represents an important step forward in forecasting lung pathology. This suggests a direction for clinical studies and further research in medical image-processing technology.

articleTitle: LookCursorAI: Machine Learning-Enhanced Eye-Powered Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This project presents the development and implementation of a hands-free computer interaction system leveraging facial recognition technology.
