Aimed at enhancing accessibility for individuals with physical disabilities, the system enables users to control their computers exclusively through facial expressions and movements. By harnessing real-time detection and tracking of facial landmarks using sophisticated algorithms, the system interprets a diverse range of facial gestures, from subtle cues like blinking to more pronounced actions such as mouth movements. Through customizable thresholds and intuitive interfaces, users can seamlessly navigate interfaces, manipulate content, and communicate with others without the need for traditional input devices. The system's robust performance and user-friendly design underscore its potential to revolutionize the way individuals with disabilities engage with computing devices, fostering independence and empowerment in the digital realm. This project not only exemplifies a paradigm shift in human-computer interaction but also embodies a commitment to inclusivity and accessibility in technology design.

articleTitle: Personalized Search Engine Optimization for E-Commerce Platforms Based on Content Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the rise of the mobile Internet era, e-commerce platforms continue to increase, and users have higher and higher requirements for service quality. In order to meet the needs of users, personalized recommendation systems have emerged as an emerging business ecosystem. This article aims to study how to build a personalized information filtering system based on content and structure, and analyze the application of e-commerce companies through actual cases. First, this article introduces content retrieval technology, search engine optimization algorithms, and keyword matching methods. Content retrieval technology is a process of information retrieval by analyzing and matching text content. Search engine optimization algorithms optimize the structure and content of web pages to rank them higher in search engines and improve the effectiveness of information retrieval. The keyword matching method is to match the keywords entered by the user with the keywords of the product or service to achieve more accurate recommendation results. This article tests the performance of the search engine. The test results show that text accounts for 51%, images account for 24%, videos account for 15%, and news accounts for 10%; the matching degree range of text is 94%-100%, the matching degree range of pictures is 80%-87%, the matching degree range of video is 76%-86%, and the matching degree range of news is 75%-82%. This meets the different information needs of users.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of A Missile Guidance and Control System Model for Precise Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: A missile navigation system model is developed and analyzed in this work. The flight command structure is a crucial component which improves the efficiency of the system. It has a major impact on both the accuracy of the strike and precise control over the missile's performance. The goal of the flight command structure is to instruct the missile to follow the steering directive produced by the control system. The system's representation is determined by how well it establishes the flying course required to intercept the target and sends the commands to the attitude control system required to keep the missile on course while taking the airframe's dynamics and relevant aerodynamic characteristics into account. The missile is guided to attack the target after it has been tracked, and its trajectory is determined by the homing guidance loop utilizing the PID controller-based autopilot mode. In the MATLAB simulation environment, dynamic performance of the missile guidance system is simulated using a step response technique based on time.

articleTitle: Machine Vision-based Real-Time Onion Classification and Sorting Using YOLOv8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In India, onion (Allium cepa L.) is the most important vegetable since it includes a wide range of nutrients. Onions are high in potassium, which helps to achieve daily potassium requirements for the human body. Renal function, muscular contraction, and nerve transmission of human beings require potassium for their proper functioning. One of the most prevalent vegetables in Indian cuisine is an onion, a must-have element. Onions during storage or even before keeping in storage if are not checked for their healthy condition, start rotting. It is a tedious task to separate them manually unless they are visually inspected. In this work, we propose a real-time vision-based embedded system designed to automatically separate onions based on their appearance. A system is built around the ATMEGA 328 microcontroller, where input is captured on real time basis by feeding onion samples on the rotating disc. An onion sorter is trained on 448 image samples using a You Only Look Once v8 (YOLOv8) algorithm. The fresh and rotten onions are sorted with the help of rotating discs and servo motors which are controlled by Driver IC. The algorithm performance was evaluated by comparison with the VGG16, Inceptionv3, and YOLOv8 algorithms. Accuracy, mean Average Precision (mAP), recall, F1-score, and mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) are used for evaluation. We have attained 97.7% accuracy for classifying healthy and diseased onions with the proposed method.

articleTitle: NestedVGG: A Novel Deep Learning-based Architecture for Brain Tumour Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Brain tumors are sudden outbreak of cells in the brain or on its surface and are categorized into gliomas, meningiomas, and pituitary adenomas. Traditionally, tumors of the brain are categorized using a manual approach that includes visual examination by radiologists on Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). This is arduous and subject to inter-expert variability. In view of the subtle and fine-grained compact variations that exist in MRI images of these three types of brain tumors, this paper proposes an automated brain tumor detection system using deep learning (DL) with MRI scans. This paper presents an automated system for brain tumor detection using DL on MRI scans. The "NestedVGG" model implements transfer learning(TL) with the outer architecture of "Outer VGG" for feature extraction and the inner architecture for fine-grained identification. This "Outer VGG" utilizes a pre-trained VGG16 model to acquire information about features from MRI images. While the inner "Inner VGG" can capture minute variations between tumor types to classify glioma, meningioma, no-tumour, and pituitary cases effectively. Publicly available MRI dataset consists of three classes of tumours were used for testing and this framework has achieves accuracy of 97.71% on the test set, thus outperforming the prior methods in this task. Moreover, it has maintained its high accuracy across various types of tumors, thus making the model flexible. This paper furthers brain tumor diagnosis through an effective architecture for brain tumor identification, which can lead to advanced diagnostic tools and better patient care.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Image Recognition Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The paper aims to explore the application effects of deep learning algorithms in sports image recognition and analysis. Faced with the challenges of insufficient feature extraction ability in the field of sports image recognition. This article proposes a fusion algorithm based on CNN-GCN (Convolutional Neural Network Graph Convolutional Network). Through in-depth analysis of previous research achievements and challenges encountered, this article not only points out the limitations of traditional methods, but also demonstrates how deep learning technology effectively solves these problems. In the experimental section, it evaluated the performance of the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm and Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF) algorithm, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) algorithm in sports image recognition and analysis tasks through four different experiments. In the benchmark performance comparison experiment, the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm achieved an accuracy of 93%, and achieved recall, precision, and F1 scores of 91%, 92%, and 91.5%, respectively, all higher than other reference algorithms. In the robustness testing experiment, in the face of degraded image quality, the accuracy of CNN-GCN can also be maintained at 85%, significantly higher than the performance of SVM, RF, and MLP algorithms under the same conditions. In the experiment of dynamic scene analysis capability, the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm achieved an accuracy of 85% when dealing with high complexity dynamic scenes. In the final real-time processing capability evaluation, the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm also took the lead with a processing time of 25 milliseconds. In the data conclusion of the above experiment, the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm has shown excellent performance in the field of sports image recognition and analysis, and also reflects the enormous potential of the CNN-GCN fusion algorithm in real-time application scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Detection:Comparative Analysis of Convolutional Neural Network Architectures with Fine-Tuning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: A significant worldwide health problem that is more widespread among women in the modern era is breast cancer. Many methods have been investigated for identification of breast cancer problem, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and pre-trained models. Our study aims to enhance the efficiency and precision of breast cancer diagnosis by employing deep learning with transfer learning. In this research, we formulated different models that leverage deep learning techniques and transfer learning. The main aim was to improve and compare breast cancer detection accuracy of different architectures of CNN namely VGG16, INCEPTIONV3, XCEPTION and VGG19 by discerning between cancerous and non-cancerous regions in histopathology images. Through the utilization of a pre-trained model of architecture and subsequent fine-tuning, we achieved the best training accuracy of approximately 91.96% on the training dataset and 90.96% on the validation dataset using the VGG16 architecture.

articleTitle: SSA-Net: Semantic and Spatial Aggregation Transformer for HOI Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Human and Object Interaction (HOI) detection stands as a pivotal vision task crucial for scene comprehension, aiming to identify and locate persons and things in a still image, as well as to recognize and classify the interaction actions between humans and objects. Currently, single-stage methods are the mainstay of HOI detection because they are efficient and do not require additional post-processing. And many previous single-stage methods have adopted the Transformer-based approach, whose attention mechanism aggregates global contextual information very well, as well as set prediction and query greatly enhance the effectiveness of HOI. Based on this, we present the transformer-based HOI method SSA-Net, two new forms are then introduced to choose the most pertinent object-action pairs in the image. By introducing a category-aware module to enhance the feature representation and introducing semantic information and spatial features to further improve the effectiveness of the query. Experiments confirming the efficacy of our approach unveiled significant improvements compared to the baseline in the two major HOI baselines, HICO-DET and V-COCO.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Surface Defects In Steel Sheet Using Nearest Neighbour Region Fusion Segmentation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The Surface defects detection technique is extensively utilized in industrial settings, particularly in the inspection of steel plate surface quality. The inspection process has progressed through three stages: manual-visual inspection, traditional non-destructive testing, and machine vision detection. In the initial stage, manual visual inspection relied on human operators to visually examine steel plates for surface defects. However, this method is time-consuming and prone to errors. The second stage introduced traditional non-destructive testing methods, which typically include techniques like ultrasonic testing or magnetic particle inspection. While more efficient than manual inspection, these methods may still have limitations in terms of speed and accuracy. Therefore, this research proposed a new method to segment the surface defects in steel sheets.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of ADHD: A Machine Learning Approach with EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Recent advancements in the diagnosis of ADHD have been marked by a significant convergence of neuroimaging, computational neuroscience, and machine learning, forging new paths that substantially enhance diagnostic accuracy. Prominent research utilizing Electroencephalography (EEG) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has effectively demonstrated the potential of these technologies to accurately pinpoint ADHD with remarkable precision. For instance, advanced machine learning techniques applied to optimized EEG channels have resulted in detection accuracies as high as 97%, illustrating the robust capability of these methods. Similarly, the integration of EEG signal decomposition with deep learning has achieved a healthy success rates, indicating substantial promise in the objective identification of ADHD cases. Furthermore, models employing Gaussian SVM on EEG linear features have also reported nearly 94% accuracy, highlighting the growing precision and effectiveness of these computational tools in clinical settings. These findings underscore the evolution of ADHD diagnostic methodologies, as they increasingly incorporate sophisticated technological approaches, thus paving the way for more accurate, reliable, and sophisticated diagnostic tools. This progress not only enhances the accuracy of ADHD diagnosis but also facilitates earlier intervention strategies, ultimately improving patient care and management.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches For Lymphoma Prediction: Leveraging VGG16 and DenseNet Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Blood Cancer is a gruesome disease that causes the abnormal growth of cells in the blood, bone marrow, and lymphatic system. It uses various CT scans for the recovery or detection of blood cancer. This paper aims to predict blood cancer at an early rate, by using different Deep Learning (DL) technologies like VGG16 and DenseNet. In the medical sciences or healthcare field DL algorithms work efficiently, with innovative ideas. With their different layers, DL algorithms work better on the data set of blood cancer, the data set has mainly three classes named lymph_cll, lymph_fl, and lymph_mcl. DenseNet achieved greater accuracy than the VGG16 model. The DenseNet model achieves high performance because each layer is densely interconnected with every adjacent layer, this leads to effective information transfer by feature reuse and enhanced gradient flow, leading to its excellent results in tasks involving the classification of blood cancer, through the utilization of these developments in DL, this study seeks to progress early detection techniques and ultimately enhance patient care results in the treatment of blood cancer.

articleTitle: Detecting Ransomware in Bitcoin Network: Experimental Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Ransomware attacks, exploiting cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin for ransom payments, represent a significant cybersecurity threat. Detecting these malicious activities within the Bitcoin network is challenging due to complex transaction patterns and blockchain’s inherent anonymity. Understanding these patterns is crucial for effective defense mechanisms. However, existing research lacks comprehensive analysis of ransomware behavior on the Bitcoin network, leaving gaps in understanding. Moreover, current detection strategies often struggle to accurately identify ransomware activities. To address these gaps, this study conducted experimental research using the BitcoinHeist dataset. Employing machine learning techniques and feature engineering, the analysis aims to decipher transaction patterns and identify ransomware characteristics. The model achieves an accuracy of 85%, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting ransomware activities. By bridging theoretical knowledge with empirical analysis, this research enhances understanding and aids in developing robust defense strategies against ransomware attacks.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using AdaBoost And XGBoost Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a very noxious cancer in women worldwide, its mortality rate is increasing day by day. Researchers found various research methods for the detection of breast cancer such as mammographic images, CT scans, etc, but these are also not well suited for early prediction of breast cancer. Machine Learning (ML) is part of Artificial intelligence (AI), which has different methods for the early prediction of any disease. To identify breast cancer before its occurrence various ML algorithms are used. In this paper, two ML classifiers are used for the classification and prediction of breast cancer, such as the AdaBoost and XGBoost classifier. These classifiers use Lasso Cross Validation (CV) for the enhancement of the accuracy. AdaBoost performed better than the XGBoost classifier because AdaBoost has the quality of handling the imbalanced data effectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based College Student Uniform Classification System using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study introduces a comprehensive classification system employing a deep learning network architecture to distinguish between student uniforms from different academic years. The system was designed to tell apart uniforms that appear somewhat similar. Images of uniforms from two distinct classes were collected from our college to create a dataset with uniforms from different years. The VGG16 model was utilized to extract features from these images. These features were compressed using a Global Average Pooling layer. The final features are then fed to deep learning model. This process achieved promising results with a notable 99% validation accuracy on the uniform dataset and 80.55% on shoe dataset. The system’s high accuracy demonstrates the effectiveness of deep learning techniques in precisely classifying college uniforms, providing a reliable method for educational institutions to categorize various uniform types.

articleTitle: Event-based Robust 3D Pose Estimation Using Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Event cameras are vision sensors that detect asynchronous changes in luminance for each pixel. They are effective for 3D pose estimation in poorly illuminated environments since they have a wider dynamic range than conventional RGB cameras. Hence, they are expected to be used as surveillance cameras for detecting suspicious persons, especially at night. However, practical applications are hindered by the high cost of event cameras and the difficulty of their synchronization. To address the limited widespread use of event cameras, we ensure practicality by implementing monocular pose estimation. Common methods for event-based pose estimation involve creating a frame that combines a set number of asynchronous events. With these methods, only changes in motion can be captured due to the nature of event cameras. This makes estimation unstable since information on joints that do not move is not collected. Therefore, we propose a stable pose estimation method that accumulates event information by incorporating past time series data. In addition, datasets for event-based pose estimation, especially those consisting of raw event data, are rare and lack diversity. To overcome the lack of data, we use data augmentation to create a robust event dataset for person localization and size estimation. Incorporating past time series data along with data augmentation enhances the versatility and accuracy of event-based monocular pose estimation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Chronic diseases are the leading cause of death and disability worldwide, necessitating early detection and management to mitigate their adverse effects on health and improve quality of life. Leveraging machine learning algorithms has become a prominent approach in predicting the risk of various chronic diseases. These algorithms excel in analyzing complex datasets to identify patterns and risk factors associated with chronic conditions. This study explores the application of two different machine learning algorithms on an open-source dataset to predict the risk of chronic diseases. The outcomes of these implementations are analyzed and discussed in the final section, providing insights into their effectiveness and potential for enhancing chronic disease management.

articleTitle: Design of Visual Analysis System for Brand Digital Marketing Based on Machine Learning Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, major enterprises are undergoing digital transformation. Big data analysis is an important means to achieve digital marketing. How to analyze and utilize big data is a question that corporate decision-makers need to think about. The article proposes a visual analysis system for brand digital marketing based on machine learning classification algorithms, uses machine learning classification algorithms to visualize digital marketing data, thereby discovering the patterns hidden behind the data. Starting from the 31st time, the accuracy rate stabilized between 93% and 96%. In 50 experiments, the highest accuracy rate reached 95.8% and the lowest accuracy rate was 90%. Then in terms of stability, in the first 20 experiments, the stability of the system was maintained between 83% and 86%.The results show that the accuracy and stability of the system have been effectively improved, and the visualization effect is also much higher than that of the traditional system. This system has been applied in the field of brand marketing and achieved good results, effectively improving the company's capabilities in brand digital marketing.

articleTitle: Soil Type Detection and Crop Prediction Using Deep Learning Method CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The study presents a novel use of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms for crop prediction and soil type classification. Soil type classification is crucial for agricultural planning and management, while accurate crop prediction aids in optimizing crop yields and resource allocation. Traditional methods for soil classification and crop prediction often rely on manual labor and subjective assessments. Our proposed CNN based approach utilizes deep learning to analyze soil properties and predict suitable crops, offering an automated and data-driven solution. Extensive trials on real-world soil and crop datasets show the efficacy of our approach, yielding encouraging accuracy and efficiency outcomes. This research contributes to advancing precision agriculture practices by providing a reliable tool for soil classification and crop prediction.

articleTitle: Construction of Digital Media AI Intelligence Based on Deep Learning and 5G Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Digital media art utilizes digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, and 5G networks to analyze user habits and design and manufacture personalized and humanized products that meet user needs and preferences. This article combined deep learning and 5G network technology to apply it to the intelligent construction of digital media AI (Artificial Intelligence) to address the efficiency issues of traditional digital media. A deep learning model architecture including neural network architecture and parameter settings was established. The computing resources provided by 5G networks were utilized to train and optimize the built models, improving their accuracy and generalization performance. This article took video data as an example, improved deep learning and 5G network technology, and compared and analyzed them with traditional algorithms. The accuracy of traditional methods for video content recognition was 0.70, and the accuracy of video content classification was 0.65; the accuracy of video content recognition for deep learning+5G (optimization algorithm 2) was 0.92, and the accuracy of video content classification was 0.87. The video data analysis test fully demonstrated the advantages of deep learning and 5G network technology in the construction of digital media AI intelligence.

articleTitle: Overflow Prevention and Wastewater Harmony: Innovative Strategies for Urban Drain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Overflow and blockages are problems that urban drainage systems must overcome to be managed effectively. This paper offers a novel solution using an intelligent sewage system to address these problems. The system efficiently prevents overflow incidents and mitigates blockages by integrating real-time monitoring of water levels and flow rates. When our strategically positioned sensors within the drainage network detect water levels above 75%, a suction pump is activated. This pump ensures maximum storage capacity and prevents overflow by moving water to a reservoir until the levels drop to 45%, as tracked by our sensors. The system also monitors water flow rates concurrently. When flow is constant, operations continue, and when it decreases, a blockage warning is issued. In addition to promoting sustainability and resilience in urban wastewater infrastructure, this proactive approach improves urban drain management by anticipating and addressing possible overflow and blockage scenarios. In addition to improving environmental protection and urban livability, the proposed system is a major advancement in reducing the risks related to urban drainage.

articleTitle: Exploring Emotion: Sentiment Analysis of Text Usage in Social Media Communication Using Ensemble Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper highlights the importance of sentiment analysis for text data mining and natural language processing (NLP) and goes into great length about it. Given that Twitter is a widely used medium for opinion and sentiment expression, finding sentiment within its massive dataset is crucial. The study uses a wide range of approaches and procedures to investigate different aspects of sentiment analysis on Twitter. Using ensemble models to improve accuracy and efficiently analyze tweets is one noteworthy feature of this research. Ensemble models provide a strong method for sentiment analysis by combining several learning algorithms to increase predictive accuracy. The study clarifies the advantages and drawbacks of using ensemble models in conjunction with other approaches, including lexicon-based tactics, machine learning algorithms, and complex deep learning.

articleTitle: Predicting Bank Loan Eligibility with Machine Learning : A Comparative Study of Advanced Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents a unique way for determining client loan eligibility utilizing powerful machine learning algorithms and data from several institutions. It focuses on the crucial phases of data purification, attribute selection, and comparative study of several machine learning approaches such as Gradient Boosting, CatBoost, XGBoost, AdaBoosting, and LightGBM. The study emphasizes the value of ensemble models in enhancing forecast accuracy and lowering default risk. Using cutting-edge machine learning techniques, this study offers banks and financial institutions with a powerful tool for improving loan eligibility checks. The suggested technique is shown to be reliable and effective through empirical validation and practical implementations.

articleTitle: Multi-feature image analysis for Android malware classification using convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Mobile security threats have increased due to the growing popularity of Android apps, especially in malware detection. Current methods give good performance in binary classification but most have difficulty in multi-class classification. This study introduces a novel approach to enhance multi-class classification of Android malware through image-based classification. The proposed system performs a conversion of Android application files into specialized images, including Markov, Entropy graph, and Gray-level matrix images. This set of images is used to train fine-tuned CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) models and it shows better performance than existing techniques. Experiments were conducted on the latest Android benchmark dataset CICMalDroid 2020. The method achieves an accuracy of 94.79% and 1.3% false positive rate.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Personalized Recommendation System for Online Learning Resources Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Nowadays, a vast amount of knowledge can lead to a lack of interest and a loss of direction for English learners. This article was based on a knowledge graph and proposed a personalized test question recommendation algorithm based on the knowledge graph of knowledge points. A method based on the loss rate of student knowledge points was proposed, which selected the knowledge points that students had poor mastery as recommendation questions and recommended them from candidate questions according to the recommendation degree. Based on the personalized test question recommendation algorithm based on knowledge graph, a personalized recommendation system for English learning platform based on big data was constructed. Before using the system in this article, student number 1 scored 62 points, and after using the system, the score was 90 points. By using the previous student number 2, the score was 64 points, and after using it, the score was 78 points. All students have improved their grades. This system can help improve the academic performance of English learners.

articleTitle: Acute Ischemic Brain Stroke Classification Using Attention-Augmented Ensemble Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Acute Ischemic Brain Disorder, also known as an (AIS) Acute Ischemic Stroke, takes place when a blood clot blocks a brain blood vessel, leading to oxygen deprivation and potential brain damage. Clinical analysis techniques with the help of Computer Tomography (CT) scans with Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) helps in visualizing the brain and in the assessment of blockage related characteristics. This procedure is not always quick and accurate for the detection of mild, atypical or the variety of other patterns related to symptoms present in an MRIs. This research is an attempt to address these limitations with the development of AI-based automated deep learning technique. In this work, an ensemble consists of fine-tuned ResNet50 and EfficientNetB0 models and the output obtained from these models present in an ensemble are passed to the self-attention module which helps in focusing the relevant features. Finally, these features were used for the classification of MRI images affected with the Acute Ischemic brain stroke. The experimental results imply that the proposed method has compassed a classification accuracy of 95.00% in classifying the brain stroke MRI images which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method in the classification of Acute Ischemic stroke.

articleTitle: The Framework of Dynamic Data Permission Control Based on Organizational Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Data permission control is a crucial means to ensure system security. The core of data permission control lies in the fact that users with different roles have access to different ranges of data. A generic, easily scalable and maintainable data permission framework that is decoupled from the business system plays a significant role in enhancing system security, improving user experience, reducing the complexity of authorization management, and achieving fine-grained permission control. Current methods of data permission control, to varying degrees, either bind data permissions and functional permissions together or fall short in reducing the complexity of authorization management or achieving the flexibility and universality of fine-grained permission control. This article proposes a dynamic data permission control model based on organizational structure, which divides data permissions according to the organizational structure and can dynamically configure data permissions for the functional permissions held by roles, supporting custom data permission configurations. Finally, the framework is implemented using the Spring Security and Mybatis frameworks, adopting the AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) technology. Through its application in actual business systems, the framework has been verified to be reasonable and feasible, exhibiting excellent universality and flexibility.

articleTitle: Deep Diving into VGG19 CNN Model driven Coral Health Monitoring for Sustainable Reef Conservation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Examining Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transfer Learning applications in coral reef conservation is the aim of this research project. To this end, it provides a collection of 923 images that classify corals as either bleached or healthy. The aim of this study is to provide an automated picture classification model based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) as a means of addressing the labor-intensive process of manually identifying coral reefs. Given the importance of coral reefs in the ecology and the difficulties they face, including coral bleaching, this is very important. This approach uses training, validation, and testing datasets together with the VGG19 pre-trained CNN model. The procedure of model monitoring is carried out by use of calls. The batch size, epochs, and input shape of the model are among its hyperparameters, and they are all given in an understandable and brief way. Among the most often used evaluation metrics in machine learning are the classification report, confusion matrix, and accuracy. The study shows how the suggested paradigm is efficient, scalable, and has real-time monitoring capabilities. The accomplishment of an accuracy rate of 74%, which shows good results, demonstrates the ability of CNNs to quickly identify and monitor the health of coral reefs. This is absolutely essential to carry out conservation actions and to make well-informed decisions.

articleTitle: Advancing Speech Disorder Diagnostics: CNN Innovations in Dysarthria Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Neurological disorders such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and cerebral palsy (CP) are common causes of dysarthria, the subject of this research article. The capacity to communicate is greatly affected by dysarthria, thus early diagnosis is critical for effective therapies and improved patient outcomes. The study employed a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for speech classification using the TORGO database, which includes 2000 samples of individuals with and without dysarthria, representing different genders. With 500 samples each, collected over distinct sessions, the dataset contains both dysarthric and non-dysarthric people of both sexes. Distinguishing between dysarthric and non-dysarthric occurrences, the CNN-based approach achieves an astonishing 96% accuracy. This shows how deep learning technology may help with early dysarthria identification and enable rapid therapy for affected individuals. The findings of this study have important implications for the development of diagnostic tools and may lead to better living conditions for those who struggle with speaking.

articleTitle: Enhancing OCT Image Classification for Retinal Disease Diagnosis: A Novel Approach Using Squeeze-and-Excitation ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Millions of individuals are projected to be impacted by age-related macular degeneration (AMD), which is the primary cause of visual loss. Conversely, only a few number of highly qualified ophthalmologists are produced globally each year. Over the last decade, machine learning technologies have demonstrated significant potential to revolutionise clinical AMD care and help research for a better understanding of the disease. As a result, we developed a SeResNet architecture to categorise various AMD diseases. SeResNet is a technology for identifying retinal disorders such as Diabetic Macular Edema and Age-Related Macular Degeneration that focuses on recalibrating characteristics at the channel level which boosts decision-making, feature representation, and classification accuracy. The model was evaluated using 84,495 images categorised as CNV, DME, Drusen, or Normal. To determine which model performs best, we trained four alternative models. The results show that SeResNet performs very well, with recall and precision scores up to 1.00 across a variety of categories and an overall accuracy score of 99%. In particular, SeResNet helps for earlier detection of diseases and better treatment for patients by decreasing the requirement for on-site examinations. This paper highlights the utility of SeResNet model in ophthalmology. In addition, by analyzing the most sophisticated AI techniques for OCT imaging, it offers recommendations for more study and technical developments.

articleTitle: Utilizing Hybrid Intelligence: A CNN-SVM Method for Accurate Classification of Neem Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This research presents a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture augmented with support vector machine (SVM) integration for the classification of various diseases affecting neem leaves. The CNN component comprises three convolutional layers followed by three max-pooling layers, extracting hierarchical features from input data. Each convolutional layer employs rectified linear unit (ReLU) activation functions, enhancing the network's non-linearity. The feature vectors obtained from the CNN layers are fed into a fully connected layer, serving as input to the SVM classifier. The SVM classifier utilizes these feature vectors to delineate decision boundaries between different disease classes. The amalgamation of CNN and SVM outputs through ensemble techniques enriches classification accuracy. The proposed hybrid model is trained and evaluated using labeled datasets of neem leaf diseases, optimizing parameters through grid search and cross-validation. Comparative analysis with individual CNN and SVM models validates the efficacy of model fusion, affirming its potential for precise disease prediction in neem leaves.

articleTitle: A Systematic Approach on Attention Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis in Convolutional Neural Network using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis represents an emerging field of study in both natural language processing and computational intelligence with consumer evaluations of products and services are advancing in autonomy. Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to determine a user’s sentiment using multimodal data. It seeks to describe a novel approach to sentiment categorization that employs deep learning and natural language processing. The proposed framework for attention-based multimodal sentiment classification combines convolutional neural networks for image data with bidirectional encoder representations from transformers for textual data. The synergy between these two modalities enhances the model’s capability of capturing abundant contextual information and visual signals. The framework employs a convolutional neural network for image data that recovers hierarchical features while preserving spatial relationships. Simultaneously, the BERT model encodes textual information, enabling the model to comprehend semantic sequence. Combining these modalities requires an attention mechanism to learn and dynamically evaluate the importance of visual and textual signals during classification. Attention-based fusion enhances sentiment categorization performance by focusing on the most informative elements from both modalities. Extensive evaluations utilizing the publicly available CMU Multimodal Opinion Sentiment and Emotion Intensity dataset demonstrate the utility of the proposed framework with an accuracy of 95.87%. The experimental findings indicate that the convolutional neural network with the BERT method captures complex sentiment patterns across various domains more effectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing Footwear Image Classification with Hyperparameter Tuning: Insights from the UTZappos Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this research, we delve into the realm of footwear image classification utilizing the UTZappos shoe dataset. Employing a suite of convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, namely ResNet, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and Modified VGG19, we explore their efficacy in accurately categorizing shoe images. Our findings reveal that EfficientNet emerges as the top-performing model, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 90.02%. This study not only contributes to the field of computer vision and deep learning but also holds practical implications for the fashion industry. By facilitating efficient image sorting and retrieval, our approach can enhance user experience on fashion websites, allowing seamless browsing and discovery of visually similar footwear items, regardless of color variations. Ultimately, this technology has the potential to drive increased engagement and sales by providing consumers with personalized and intuitive shopping experiences.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Automatic Noisy Speech Classification for Enhanced Speech Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In real-life scenarios, the speech signals are often corrupted by various background noises such as vehicles, trains, fans, wind, rain, air-conditioners, and machinery sounds. Hence, ensuring the quality of speech signals is most important for the efficient performance of speech and audio processing systems. In this paper, we study the performance of deep learning-based noisy speech classification (NSC) methods for noise-specific speech denoising or speech enhancement for better noise reduction and preserving speech intelligibility and naturalness. We explore the performance of the autocorrelation function and spectrogram features in combination with 1D and 2D convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) methods. The proposed NSC method is evaluated using a large dataset comprising noise free and noisy speech signals corrupted with five types of noise at different noise amplitude levels. Experimental results demonstrate that the spectrogram-based LSTM method achieves an overall accuracy (ACC) 99.60% with a model size of 11.6 MB and a computational time of 0.47 ms. The huge computational complexity reduction using the lightweight NSC methods can improve the energy efficiency and battery life of edge speech analysis systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agricultural Sustainability: SARIMA and SVM Models for Precise Rainfall Forecasting and Environmental Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The effectiveness of crop cycle planning relies on accurate precipitation forecasts, effective disaster prevention, and comprehensive examination of environmental conditions. Precise rainfall prediction suffers from notable changes in precipitation patterns. To improve rainfall forecast accuracy this study uses SVM (Support Vector Machine) and SARIMA (Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) models. Crucially for solving climate-related issues, the SARIMA model estimates future values, therefore offering a better knowledge of precipitation patterns and dynamics. Precise precipitation control guarantees the availability and sustainability of fresh water, therefore emphasising its essential part in environmental management and resource economy. With a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 232.41 and a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 23.63 the models performed.

articleTitle: Transforming Indian Digital Landscapes: A Study on Generative AI-Powered Voice Assistants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study presents the development and evaluation of a generative AI-powered voice assistant designed to transform India's digital landscape. Leveraging advanced AI technologies, the assistant enhances daily interactions and improves accessibility within India's diverse cultural and linguistic context. Key challenges addressed include the integration of accurate and ethical content filtering and the enhancement of system efficiency and responsiveness tailored to Indian users. The AI voice assistant was developed using deep learning and natural language processing techniques. The text-to-speech module utilized the 'pyttsx3' library, while the 'speech_recognition' module enabled robust speech-to-text capabilities. Convolutional and recurrent neural networks were employed for image analysis and sequential data processing. Data management was handled through JSON files, ensuring efficient storage and retrieval of command structures and responses. The Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) was used for tasks such as tokenization and stemming. The AI model was trained using PyTorch, with a focus on optimizing parameters. The system achieved a 95% accuracy rate in user interactions, demonstrating significant advancements in task completion and user satisfaction. Testing was conducted on an NVIDIA DGX STATION A100. This study underscores the transformative potential of AI-powered voice assistants in reshaping India's digital landscape, promoting inclusivity and efficiency.

articleTitle: Chest X-ray Classification Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study demonstrates how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming medical diagnosis, particularly for respiratory disorders such as COVID-19 and influenza. The project aims to enhance global healthcare systems by accurately and rapidly identifying respiratory disorders through AI-driven chest X-ray analysis. Given the significant public health implications of infections like COVID-19, the importance of this work is paramount. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are employed to analyze chest X-ray images and detect patterns indicative of viral infections. Key components of the project include convolutional blocks, the RMSprop optimizer, 2D max pooling, dropout regularization, and the categorical cross-entropy loss function. Two CNN models are developed from scratch to balance complexity and efficacy in X-ray image classification.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection Using EfficientNetB7 and L1-Regularized Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The Indian economy heavily relies on agriculture, making it crucial to address plant diseases promptly to prevent significant losses in production and economic setbacks. Manual monitoring of plant health is labor-intensive and time-consuming, hence utilizing image processing techniques, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks, presents a viable solution. In this work, a pre trained model called EfficientNetB7 used for feature extraction and a neural network with L1 regularization is developed for finding the disease. The suggested model underwent training using a dataset of 4000 images depicting both diseased and healthy plant leaves. The objective was to build a precise technique for diagnosing plant illnesses by analyzing leaf data. This approach aims to streamline disease detection, enabling timely intervention to mitigate losses and enhance agricultural sustainability in India.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Summarization Using Contemporary Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In order to summarize complex datasets for exploratory data analysis, this study investigates the efficacy of clustering algorithms such Spectral Clustering, Mean-shift Clustering, KMeans Clustering, DBSCAN Clustering, and Agglomerative hierarchical Clustering. Strong performance from clusters KMeans, Spectral, and Mean-shift is revealed by evaluating metrics such silhouette scores, Davies-Bouldin scores, and Calinski-Harabasz scores. The ensemble clusters K-Means, DBSCAN, and Agglomerative Heirarchial Clustering exhibit the best overall performance. Case studies from a variety of fields, including anomaly detection and document clustering, emphasize the practical uses of clustering by showcasing its capacity to produce informative data summaries.

articleTitle: Do Large Language Models solve Computer Science problems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Large Language models have transformed natural language processing tasks, with excellent abilities to understand problems and answer them in simple English. This paper undertakes a comprehensive analysis of different Large Language Models to determine their efficiency in solving a large range of question-answer problems where the major focus was on various Types of Questions. Extensive experiments targeting LLMs such as Chat GPT-3.5, BARD, and Bing were done to perform tasks on specific subjects. Secondly, the work focuses on solving domain-specific problems in software and electrical domains. Through experimentation and efforts, using the available LLMs and tools to solve the problem, analyze and compare the problem-solving skills in terms of accuracy, effort reduction, and automation. Further, we investigate the adaptability of each model to the intricacies of various question formats and domain-specific knowledge.Our findings offer valuable insights presenting the strengths and limitations of different LLMs. This research contributes to the ongoing effort to better understand prompts and enhance understanding regarding the selection of LLMs for specific applications to ease the work.

articleTitle: An algorithm for the multi-depot, multi-vehicle routing problem with capacity constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) is a critical problem in transportation logistics and other applications of operations research. Route planning and scheduling are essential tasks in many practical scenarios, such as vehicle routing and assigning robots to multiple service locations. These problems involve allocating entities like delivery vehicles or robots to service targets while minimizing an objective, such as the total distance covered. This problem is generally NP-hard. First, we present an approximation algorithm for the VRP and demonstrate that it achieves an approximation ratio of 2. Next, we examine a capacitated version of this problem, known as the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP). For this, we propose an adaptation of Prim’s minimum spanning tree algorithm to provide an approximate solution. We demonstrate the performance of this algorithm through simulations. The primary focus of our work is the development of a lightweight solution, particularly useful in scenarios where CVRP instances must be solved repeatedly.

articleTitle: Enhanced Quantum Neural Networks: A Full Entanglement Scheme for Binary Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In this article, we introduce a novel approach for enhancing the performance of Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) through variations in entanglement schemes within variational forms. Our main objective in this research is to improve the performance of QNNs, specifically focusing on their application in classification tasks. We tested three models, each with a different type of entanglement scheme: Linear Entanglement, Circular Entanglement, and our proposed Full Entanglement. Each model consisted of three layers of Ry parameterized gates. We used the Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) dataset and encoded it using the ZZ-feature Map. Then we used this encoded data for training our models and evaluated them based on metrics such as training and validation loss. Our experimental results demonstrate that increasing entanglement can mitigate overfitting, with the proposed Full Entanglement scheme showing the most promising results.

articleTitle: Fusion of Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forests for Accurate Potato Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In order to classify potato leaf diseases, this work suggests a hybrid model that combines a Random Forest classifier for sample class classification with a CNN for image feature extraction. The dataset obtained from Kaggle includes 1885 samples of different potato leaf illnesses caused by fungi, viruses, pests, bacteria, Phytophthora, nematodes, and healthy leaves. Thorough preprocessing entails dividing the dataset into equal training, testing, and validation sets and downsizing photos to a standard dimension. The CNN model uses ReLU activation for normalization and softmax activation for classification. It has five layers with progressively larger filter sizes. For the final label classification, features taken from the CNN are fed into a Random Forest classifier consisting of 100 decision trees. The suggested model shows promise in terms of performance and accuracy in classifying diseases. The hybrid model suggested for classifying diseases affecting potatoes shows encouraging results; it has an overall accuracy rate of 77% and a precision range of 44% to 96% for various disease categories.

articleTitle: Neural Network Model Music Data Recommendation Algorithm based on Deep Belief
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: With the development of the Internet and the emergence of music platforms, users have put forward higher requirements for personalized music recommendations. To solve this problem, this paper studied a personalized music recommendation method based on Deep Belief Network (DBN) to improve the accuracy of music recommendation and user satisfaction. In this paper, a new neural network model based on deep belief was proposed and its implementation was discussed. In the satisfaction experiment test, the algorithm adopted in this paper got an average score of 9.5, which was far higher than the traditional 6.3. Experiments have showed the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Bounding Box Aware Edge-Cloud Collaborative Method for Multiple Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The demand for real-time video processing from edge devices including surveillance cameras and smartphones has been increasing. While edge processing power is improving with lighter recognition models and smaller GPUs, achieving high-performance recognition remains a challenge due to limited computational resources. To address the issue, collaborative recognition systems between the edge side and the cloud side are crucial. Previous approaches such as the Edge-Cloud Net (ECNet) have been proposed but they faced challenges in optimizing data transmission because of the large data size of frame images. In this paper, we propose a novel edge-cloud collaborative method for video multiple object detection. This system integrates an original lightweight edge side model that combines YOLOv3 and YOLOv3-tiny and compresses intermediate features before the transmission. Our approach improves the trade-off between transmission amount and detection accuracy, particularly at low bit rates. This approach also focuses on offload controlling based on detected bounding boxes from the edge side model and it enhances the trade-off compared to the previous method.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of CSRR Loaded High Gain Multiband Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna Array (1x2) for IoT and Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This study presents the design, fabrication, and measurement of a high-gain dual-band antenna with dimensions of 60mm x 100mm x1.6mm, specifically for microwave frequencies. This antenna has a 1x2 element array, is powered by a microstrip corporate feeding network, and operates at frequencies of 1.624 GHz and 2.45 GHz. The simulation and measurement results indicate that the proposed Antenna demonstrates promising performance. For instance, it exhibits an impedance bandwidth of 27.9 MHz at a resonating frequency of 1.624 GHz, with a |S 11|<-10dB. Additionally, at a resonating frequency of 2.45 GHz, it has an impedance bandwidth of 359.7 MHz and a return loss (S11) of -41.199 dB. At 1.624 GHz, the maximum surface current is 126.7 A/m, while at 2.45 GHz, it is 27.73 A/m. Furthermore, by the application of numerical analysis on the patch's size, this antenna exhibits a significant enhancement in gain at a certain resonant frequency, when compared to several alternative scenarios. Moreover, the antenna's resonance frequency precisely corresponds to 1.624 GHz and 2.45 GHz, serving as the center frequency. Additionally, it demonstrates a VSWR value that is almost identical to 1. In addition, it demonstrates a gain of approximately 5.471 dBi at a frequency of 1.624 GHz and 9.497dBi at a frequency of 2.45 GHz. Further, if CSRR is introduced at ground Surface, Bandwidth improvement is achieved from 359.7 MHz to 451.2 MHz with gain remaining intact. This antenna has the ability to offer a dependable method of connecting devices that are based on the Internet of Things (IoT).

articleTitle: Enhanced License Plate Detection using YOLOv8n: An Approach for Efficient Vehicle Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: An essential feature of the intelligent transportation system is the automatic detection and recognition of license plate information. The e-payment systems for parking and toll collection in traffic control security could be utilized with this application. Numerous algorithms have been created for License Plate Recognition (LPR) and Identification, each with pros and cons depending on the circumstances. Computer vision has increased in terms of techniques and developments since deep learning emerged and became popular in several artificial intelligence domains. It is one of the most efficient ways to monitor traffic signals, tax paid for parking, and police monitoring through Automatic LPR. Although it, as a technology, is widely used and developed, much more must be done to improve the system's accuracy. The current science community has excelled in efficiency and problem-solving in recent years. Along with the You Only Look Once (YOLO), targeted at the object detection area and applied to this study, our primary goal is to summarize and analyze several methods and advancements in LPR in the deep learning age.

articleTitle: Multi-classifier approach to detect Alzheimer's Disease based on Handwriting Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a degenerative brain condition that predominantly impacts older individuals, resulting in a gradual decline in cognitive function and memory. Effective management and treatment of AD rely heavily on early detection. In this study, we propose a machine learning (ML) model for predicting AD using a dataset of handwriting tasks performed by test subjects with varying degrees of cognitive impairment. Handwriting analysis has shown potential as a low-cost, non-invasive method for early AD identification. These data were used to train various ML classifiers to classify individuals as either AD or non-AD. Baseline evaluations were conducted using multiple classifiers on the entire feature set and on individual tasks. The insights gained from these evaluations were then utilized to create a more optimized model combining the strength of multiple classifiers with the help of the TOPSIS method. The optimized model achieved a promising accuracy of 97% on the test set, demonstrating its potential for early AD detection. Our findings suggest that handwriting analysis, coupled with ML techniques, holds significant promise as a tool for early AD prediction and warrants further investigation.

articleTitle: Design of Artificial Intelligence Digital Teaching Platform Based on PSO-LSSVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The teaching platform based on learning algorithms is a product of the continuous deepening of modern education and teaching reform. It is an important practice of the application of Internet technology in teaching, and also a major means to realize the new teaching model of "Internet plus education". The AI (Artificial Intelligence) digital teaching platform is conducive to the enrichment and innovation of teaching modes, teaching methods, and teaching content. At the same time, it is also conducive to the realization of personalized and self-directed learning goals for students. The personalized teaching platform based on learning algorithms has made up for various shortcomings in classroom teaching and improved the effectiveness of learning. The article combines particle swarm optimization algorithm and least squares support vector machine algorithm to design an AI digital teaching platform. At the same time, performance testing was conducted on the platform, and compared with other algorithms, it was found that its predicted average score had the smallest difference from the actual score, only 0.8. Moreover, the estimated teaching effectiveness is not significantly different from the actual value, with an error interval of [0.23,0.81] and an average error of only 0.56.

articleTitle: Baby Emotion Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This paper presents an application of MFCC (Mel frequency cepstral coefficients) Using auditory data, this study introduces a system for recognizing emotions in infants between the ages of one and seven months. Speech processing is one of the processes for classification of baby emotions while the other is facial recognition. This section extracts feature related to baby emotions expressions. The system uses its delta cepstrum coefficients and common Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) as vocalization features in the speech processing section which can be detected by the audio files that are less than 10sec in duration or length. This architecture offers an efficient tool for verification of "universal baby language"

articleTitle: Helmet and Number Plate Detection using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In an era embarked by technological advancements, enhancing the efficiency of law enforcement processes is crucial for maintaining public safety. This paper presents a comprehensive study on "Helmet and Number Plate Detection using YOLOv8," focusing on developing an intelligent system to automate the monitoring of traffic rule violations. By leveraging the YOLOv8 object detection algorithm, we conducted extensive data collection and preprocessing to train our model on real-world traffic scenarios. Our system was trained on a dataset of 3000 images with text annotations, achieving a precision of 92.55% for helmet detection and high accuracy in number plate recognition. The results demonstrate the system's robustness in varying lighting conditions and congested traffic environments. The integration of an advanced API for number plate recognition further enhances the system's performance. This study aims to contribute to traffic management optimization by automating the identification of violations related to helmet usage and proper display of vehicle number plates, ultimately enabling efficient challan generation and improving road safety.

articleTitle: Digital Optimization of Film and Television in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The traditional film and television industry faces many challenges and opportunities, which require digital transformation to improve the quality, audience experience, and commercial returns of film and television works. This study adopts a comprehensive literature analysis and case study approach to conduct in-depth research on digital optimization of film and television. Firstly, through literature analysis, it aims to understand the current application status and trends of artificial intelligence technology in the field of film and television. Secondly, case studies can be used to explore successful applications of artificial intelligence technology for digital optimization in film and television projects, and to analyze their return on investment and commercial effects. Research has found that the return on investment in this article ranges from 20% to 40%. In the era of artificial intelligence, digital optimization of film and television has important commercial and economic value. Through precise audience positioning, personalized recommendations, and refined marketing, artificial intelligence technology can achieve better market analysis and business decision-making, attract more audiences, and increase box office revenue.

Author Keywords: digital optimization of film and television

articleTitle: Design of Carbon GSP Business Data Integration Platform Based on JavaEE Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Data handover, data security, and data integration of the Carbon GSP business data integration platform are important issues currently faced. There is no synergy in carbon emission reduction among users, so it is urgent to establish a carbon GSP business data integration platform for the whole society to realize data exchange between users and enterprises. This article designs a carbon GSP business data integration platform based on JavaEE (Java Enterprise Edition) technology, aiming to achieve efficient data interoperability and data integration, improve data security, prevent data leakage and abuse, and improve the performance of the platform. This article will prepare data volumes of 1000, 2000, 3000,…,20000, and perform repeated data integration operations on the data volume through the Carbon GSP Business Data Integration Platform to test the performance of the platform's data integration. In the performance test, the data integration efficiency of the Carbon GSP business data integration platform based on JavaEE technology was the highest, both above 95%. Through experiments, it can be seen that the Carbon GSP business data integration platform based on JavaEE technology can integrate data more efficiently, respond faster to users, and have higher accuracy and lower error rate during data integration. The Carbon GSP business data integration platform using JavaEE technology can provide users with efficient, secure and stable data management solutions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accuracy in Automatic License plate Recognition Systems with Improved Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The paper utilizes the YOLOv8 algorithm to examine the impact of dataset quality on the effectiveness of Automatic License plate Recognition (ALPR) systems. The performance of models trained on the original Application-oriented License plate (AOLP) dataset, which exhibited some annotation inaccuracies, and the one trained on a meticulously corrected version was analyzed. The analysis reveals that the model trained with the accurately annotated dataset exhibited an improved F-score of 97.18%, compared to 87.98% with the original dataset, while maintaining the same processing speed of 18.4 milliseconds per image. This improvement emphasises the significance of an accurately annotated dataset. The research highlights the critical role of data quality in developing efficient and reliable ALPR systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Facial Expression Recognition with a Directional Attentive Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The proposed DANN was developed for better recognition of facial expression. The proposed DANN combines the attention and directional filters, which filter out features that focus on the informative facial regions while capturing the directional patterns in the facial queue. The average accuracy after benchmarking all the 10 experiment trials was in the very high level with the proposed DANN on datasets combining CK+, FER2013, and RAF-DB, with an average accuracy of 88.04%. The model showed a good trade-off between precision and recall: its average weighted F1 score was 0.881, while the average precision and recall were 0.883. This implies that the model will maximize the identification of true positive samples while, at the same time, minimizing that of false positives and false negatives. All these results are indicative of the robustness and reliability of the DANN architecture in classifying the facial expressions correctly across the different datasets and different experimental settings. The results suggest the high potential of DANN in furthering the state-of-the-art facial expression recognition with prosperous affective computing, human-computer interaction, and psychology.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Landslides Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Slope stability and stabilization techniques in the Keralan cities of Thrissur, Idukki, Ernakulum, and Pathanamthitta are the focus of this research. The landslip that occurred in Thrissur, India, between 2017 and 2023 was a deliberate rock slide down a steep, sloping road cut. There are some very steep gradients along national highways in Idukki. In August of 2022, landslides in Ernakulum closed National Highway 154. The complicated landslip is a catastrophic failure that will affect people's lives and the economy. LSMs may be found in Thrissur, Idukki, Ernakulum, and Pathanamthitta. Approximately 44.5% of the land in the studied area of Ernakulum was found to be in a vulnerable zone with a risk level between moderate and high, as determined by research conducted by LSM. The landslip at Idukki impacted the entire site, marking it as "very vulnerable." Total station data was used to create a comprehensive database of landslides in the Keralan districts of Thrissur, Idukki, Ernakulam, and Pathanamthitta. All research locations were found to be along major national routes.

articleTitle: A Novel CNN Model for Monkeypox Classification and Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: The paper introduces a novel convolutional neural network (CNN) model called "CNN model", which is specifically designed to classify and detect red dots using skin images. A dataset containing 3,192 images, which is divided into training sets (2,297 images) and testing sets (325 images), is used in this study. The design is carefully designed and includes key elements such as convolution layer, max pooling layer, sequence layer, output layer and fully connected layer, which proves its effectiveness in extracting important features and improving classification accuracy. The model was trained 100 times with a batch size of 32 and then rigorously evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1 Score to evaluate its performance. The CNN model performed well, achieving an accuracy of 0.9939 on training data and 0.9148 on testing data. Precision, recall, and F1 scores measured for monkeypox and non-monkeypox showed good model accuracy in classifying monkeypox populations. The results highlight the potential of the CNN model as an important tool to improve the diagnosis and management of measles, especially in rural areas where it is rarely treated, by helping to detect the disease early and accurately.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: Skin cancer, a widespread and potentially fatal malignancy, originates from the abnormal proliferation of skin cells, emphasizing the significance of early detection for effective treatment. Deep learning (DL) techniques, notably convolutional neural networks (CNNs), offer promise in the analysis of skin lesion images. This research study aims to compare various Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) classifier models using DL for skin cancer detection. The primary objective is to evaluate the effectiveness and performance of these CNN models in accurately classifying the type of skin cancer. To address the class imbalance, the data was first augmented, after which it was normalized to scale pixel values. Throughout the research, six CNN models were evaluated under different configuration settings, and the results were presented through tabulations, providing insights into their comparative performance. These outcomes contribute to the field of skin cancer detection by shedding light on the effectiveness of DL models. The analysis conducted in this study concludes that the highest results were recorded at an accuracy of 99.73% by ResNet50 using the Adam optimizer at a learning rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>.

articleTitle: Maizeleafnet Model for Early Identification and Classification of Multi-Class Maize Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning techniques have demonstrated exceptional efficiency in the field of digital image-driven farming identification of diseases. An approach based on deep learning has been presented in this article to identify images of a field-infected maize crop. By using the Kaggle repository, the non-intrusive images were collected with an additional focus on three significant diseases: common rust, blight and grey spot along with a healthy class. Using rotation enhancement and luminosity enhancement strategies, false images were produced to solve the issue of unequal class distribution. Using images of diseased maize, three distinct architectures built on the CNN network mechanism were trained for the current investigation. The top-performing algorithm obtained an acceptable recall of 0.82 and a classification accuracy of 99.1% on the different test datasets. This displays the potential application of the initial approach to train the proposed model for improved feature extraction and learning. The overall performance analysis shows that the proposed model is more effective and optimal in comparison to existing models with the least value of accuracy.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Dermatology by Revolutionizing Early Skin Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd World Conference on Applied Intelligence and Computing (AIC)
abstract: This work aims to provide an early skin cancer detection Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method. The approach makes use of pictures of either benign or malignant moles using a dataset obtained from the ISIC Archive. Using a deep learning model, this research effort will advance automated classification. This is recognition of how important ocular diagnostics are to the detection of skin cancer. Data loading, category labelling, normalisation, and model building with Keras and TensorFlow backend connection are among the main steps of the 14-step process. As demonstrated by the astounding accuracy and precision score of 92.7%, the dataset's balanced nature makes accuracy evaluation possible. The outcome of this work show the potential value of the created model as well as the necessity of early diagnosis in the field of skin cancer. Furthermore investigated is the integration of the ResNet50 architecture, which enhances the model's performance even further. This all-inclusive method highlights the potential of automated solutions to support the early and accurate detection of skin cancer and demonstrates how well CNNs do in visually identifying skin lesions.
